exercises.cue: Full push-ups, chest to the floor, even when your lungs are on fire.
exercises.avoid: Resting in the plank between push-ups.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swings + sprint
steps: Do the kettlebell swings at the start line.
Park the bell safely behind the line.
Sprint the full 15 m.
Walk back and go again.
exercises.cue: Snap your hips on every swing, then carry that snap into the sprint.
exercises.avoid: Dropping the bell; park it under control.

exercises.name: Slow goblet squats + sprint
steps: Hold a heavy dumbbell or kettlebell at your chest.
Do the squats slowly: four seconds down, a pause, then stand.
Put the weight down and sprint the full 15 m straight away.
Walk back and go again.
exercises.cue: Slow and heavy, then as fast as possible.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the squats to get to the sprint.

exercises.name: Ball slams + sprint
steps: Do the ball slams at the start line.
Sprint the full 15 m.
Walk back.
Go straight into the next set of slams.
exercises.cue: Slam with your whole body, then sprint with the same aggression.
exercises.avoid: Slamming a bouncy ball into your own face; use a slam ball or a dead-bounce medicine ball.

exercises.name: Farmer carry out, sprint back
steps: Pick up heavy dumbbells or kettlebells, one in each hand.
Walk them 15 m to the far end, standing tall.
Set them down and sprint back to the start.
Walk back to the weights and carry them home. Repeat.
exercises.cue: Your grip is shot when you sprint, which is exactly the point.
exercises.avoid: Dropping the weights; set them down.

exercises.name: Partner chase sprints
steps: The runner starts 2 m ahead of the chaser, both facing the far end.
On the chaser's go, both sprint 15 m.
The chaser tries to tag the runner before the far line.
Walk back and swap roles.
exercises.cue: Chasing makes everyone faster. Sprint through the line, then slow down.
exercises.avoid: Tagging with a shove; a light touch on the back is plenty.

exercises.name: Burpee sprint relay
steps: One partner sprints 15 m and back while the other does burpees nonstop.
When the runner gets back, swap: the runner starts burpees, the other sprints.
Count total burpees as a team.
Keep going until each partner has done all their lengths.
exercises.cue: The faster you sprint, the fewer burpees your partner does.
exercises.avoid: Resting instead of doing burpees while your partner runs.

exercises.name: Sprint gauntlet
steps: Mark lines at 5 m, 10 m and 15 m.
Sprint to 5 m and back, then 3 burpees.
Sprint to 10 m and back, then 3 tuck jumps.
Sprint to 15 m and back, then 3 broad jumps and a 15 m sprint. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Every sprint at full speed. When they slow down, the set is over.
exercises.avoid: Skipping the burpees' chest-to-floor to save time.

exercises.name: Table row
steps: Lie on your back under a sturdy table and grab its edge, hands shoulder-width.
Straighten your body so only your heels touch the floor.
Pull your chest up to the table edge.
Lower slowly. Bend your knees to make it easier.
exercises.cue: Test the table first: it must not tip or slide.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging as you pull.

exercises.name: One-arm table row
steps: Set up the table row, then let go with one hand and put it on your chest.
Pull yourself up with one arm, keeping your body from twisting.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.cue: Fight the twist; your body stays flat like a plank.
exercises.avoid: Rolling onto your side to cheat the rep.

exercises.name: Sliding floor pull
steps: Lie face down with a towel under your hips and thighs on a smooth floor.
Reach both arms forward, press your forearms and hands into the floor.
Pull your body forward until your hands reach your ribs.
Reach forward again and repeat for 5 m.
exercises.cue: Pull with your lats, like a pull-up lying down.
exercises.avoid: Pushing with your toes.

exercises.name: One-arm sliding floor pull
steps: Lie face down on a towel on a smooth floor.
Reach one arm forward and plant the forearm and hand.
Pull your body up to that hand using only that arm.
Keep going for 5 m, then switch arms.
exercises.cue: Brutal lat work. Stay flat and long.
exercises.avoid: Using your legs to help.

exercises.name: Pistol squat
steps: Stand on one leg, the other leg straight out in front of you, arms forward.
Squat all the way down on the standing leg, keeping the free leg off the floor.
Stand back up without touching down.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Reach your arms forward to counterbalance.
exercises.avoid: The standing heel lifting.

exercises.name: Sissy squat
steps: Stand tall, holding a wall or post lightly for balance.
Rise onto your toes and lean back as your knees travel forward and down.
Keep a straight line from knees to shoulders as you lower.
Drive back up with your quads.
exercises.cue: Hips stay forward; don't sit back.
exercises.avoid: Going deeper than your knees are ready for; build up slowly.

exercises.name: Shrimp squat
steps: Stand on one leg and grab the other foot behind you, knee bent.
Squat down on the standing leg until the back knee touches the floor.
Stand back up without letting go of the foot.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Lean your chest forward to balance.
exercises.avoid: Dropping onto the back knee; lower it softly.

exercises.name: Curtsy lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width.
Step one foot back and across behind the other, like a curtsy.
Lower until your back knee is close to the floor.
Push back to standing and switch sides.
exercises.cue: Keep your hips square to the front.
exercises.avoid: Front knee caving in.

exercises.name: Skater squat
steps: Stand on one leg, the other knee bent so that foot is behind you.
Squat down on the standing leg until the back knee touches the floor lightly.
Reach your arms forward to balance.
Stand up. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Put a folded towel where the back knee lands.
exercises.avoid: Crashing the knee down.

exercises.name: Hip airplanes
steps: Stand on one leg and hinge forward until your body is parallel to the floor, the other leg straight back.
Rotate your hips and chest open toward the ceiling on the side of the free leg.
Rotate back and past level, closing your hips toward the floor.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Slow and controlled; the standing hip does all the turning.
exercises.avoid: Losing your balance by rushing.

exercises.name: Sliding hamstring curl
steps: Lie on your back on a smooth floor, heels on a towel, knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are almost straight, hips still up.
Pull your heels back in. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Hips stay high the whole time.
exercises.avoid: Letting your hips drop as the legs straighten.

exercises.name: Single-leg sliding hamstring curl
steps: Set up the sliding hamstring curl with one heel on the towel and the other leg raised.
Bridge up on the working leg.
Slide it out and pull it back in, hips level.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Keep both hips at the same height.
exercises.avoid: Twisting toward the working side.

exercises.name: Nordic curl
steps: Kneel with your heels hooked under something heavy and stable, a folded towel under your knees.
Keep a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower yourself forward as slowly as you can, fighting with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up.
exercises.cue: The slow lowering is the whole exercise.
exercises.avoid: Bending at the hips to shorten the lever.

exercises.name: Dive-bomber push-up
steps: Start in a downward dog: hands and feet on the floor, hips high.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down and forward, close to the floor.
Keep going forward and up into a cobra, arms straight.
Push your hips back to the start.
exercises.cue: Imagine sliding under a low fence.
exercises.avoid: Dropping your hips before your chest passes your hands.

exercises.name: Archer push-up
steps: Set up a push-up with your hands very wide.
Lower toward one hand while the other arm straightens out to the side.
Press back up to the middle.
Alternate sides, or do all reps on one side first.
exercises.cue: The bent arm does the work; the straight arm only balances.
exercises.avoid: Hips twisting as you shift.

exercises.name: Pseudo-planche push-up
steps: Set up a push-up with your hands by your hips, fingers turned out.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands.
Lower your chest while keeping the lean.
Press back up without losing the lean.
exercises.cue: The further forward you lean, the harder it gets.
exercises.avoid: Drifting back to a normal push-up position.

exercises.name: One-arm push-up
steps: Set up a push-up with feet wide and one hand in the middle under your chest.
Put the other hand behind your back.
Lower your chest toward the floor without rotating.
Press back up. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.cue: Squeeze everything: glutes, abs, fist.
exercises.avoid: Twisting your hips to get up.

exercises.name: Explosive wall push-offs
steps: Stand an arm's length from a wall and fall forward onto your hands.
Bend your elbows to let your chest come close to the wall.
Push off explosively so your hands leave the wall.
Catch yourself and go straight into the next rep.
exercises.cue: Fast hands; the push is short and sharp.
exercises.avoid: Standing so far back that you can't catch yourself.

exercises.name: Kneeling plyo push-up
steps: Set up a push-up on your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land with soft elbows and go straight into the next rep.
exercises.cue: Land softly, like catching a ball.
exercises.avoid: Locking your elbows on the landing.

exercises.name: Lying windshield wipers
steps: Lie on your back, arms out wide, legs straight up (bend the knees to make it easier).
Lower both legs to one side, stopping before they touch the floor.
Bring them back up and over to the other side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor.
exercises.cue: Go only as low as you can control.
exercises.avoid: Shoulders lifting off the floor.

exercises.name: Hanging windshield wipers
steps: Hang from the bar and raise your straight legs until your toes are near the bar.
Rotate your legs down and to one side like a windshield wiper.
Sweep them back up and over to the other side.
Keep your arms straight and your body still.
exercises.cue: Pull the bar down toward your hips to stay stable.
exercises.avoid: Swinging; slow down.

exercises.name: Hollow rocks + V-ups
steps: Get into a hollow hold: lower back pressed down, arms and legs off the floor.
Rock back and forth in that shape for the rocks.
Straight into the V-ups: fold up to touch your hands to your feet.
Lower slowly each time.
exercises.cue: Keep the banana shape on every rock.
exercises.avoid: Letting the lower back peel up.

exercises.name: Dragon flag
steps: Lie on your back and grab a sturdy bench or post behind your head.
Lift your body up onto your shoulders, straight from shoulders to toes.
Lower your body as one rigid plank, as slowly as you can.
Stop just above the floor and lift back up.
exercises.cue: Only your shoulders touch the bench; don't bend at the hips.
exercises.avoid: Piking to make it easier. Tuck your knees instead.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell bench press
steps: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell, the other hand on your belly.
Press the dumbbell up without letting your body roll toward it.
Lower it slowly to your chest.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes and plant your feet; your trunk resists the twist.
exercises.avoid: Your hips sliding off the bench toward the weight.

exercises.name: Suitcase march
steps: Hold a heavy weight in one hand at your side.
Stand tall, shoulders level.
March in place, lifting each knee to hip height.
Switch hands halfway through.
exercises.cue: Don't let the weight pull you sideways.
exercises.avoid: Leaning away from the weight.

exercises.name: Bird-dog row
steps: Kneel on all fours with a dumbbell or kettlebell beside one hand.
Reach the opposite leg back into a bird dog.
Pick up the weight and row it to your hip without moving the rest of your body.
Lower it. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Pretend there's a glass of water on your lower back.
exercises.avoid: Your hips rotating open.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling Pallof + overhead press
steps: Anchor a band at chest height and kneel side-on to it, inside knee down.
Press the band straight out in front of your chest.
Then press it up overhead, still resisting the pull.
Bring it back to your chest. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Your hands stay on the midline the whole way.
exercises.avoid: Leaning toward the anchor.

exercises.name: Single-leg RDL to row
steps: Stand on one leg holding a weight in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward, the free leg reaching back, until your body is nearly parallel to the floor.
Row the weight to your hip, then lower it.
Stand back up. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Square hips throughout.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the balance.

exercises.name: Slow single-leg step-down
steps: Stand on one leg on a box or bench, the other foot hanging off the side.
Take four seconds to lower the hanging heel toward the floor, bending the standing knee.
Tap the heel lightly.
Stand back up. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: The standing knee tracks over the middle of the foot.
exercises.avoid: Dropping the last few centimetres.

exercises.name: Hop and stick, four directions
steps: Stand on one leg.
Hop forward and stick the landing for two seconds.
Hop sideways, backward and to the other side, sticking each landing. That's one round.
Finish, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Land soft and still, like a gymnast.
exercises.avoid: Hopping on before the landing is steady.

exercises.name: 180° jump turns
steps: Stand in a half squat, arms back.
Jump up and turn half a circle in the air.
Land softly facing the other way.
Turn back the other way on the next jump.
exercises.cue: Turn with your arms and hips together.
exercises.avoid: Landing with your knees caving in.

exercises.name: 360° jumps
steps: Stand in a half squat, arms back.
Jump explosively and spin a full circle.
Land softly, facing forward again.
Alternate the direction you spin.
exercises.cue: Spot a point on the wall and find it again when you land.
exercises.avoid: Landing off-balance; do 180s until the 360s are stable.

exercises.name: Cross-body mountain climbers
steps: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Switch legs quickly, like running.
Count each knee.
exercises.cue: Keep your hips low and level.
exercises.avoid: Hips bouncing up and down.

exercises.name: Kick-throughs
steps: Start in a bear position, knees just off the floor.
Lift one hand and swing the opposite leg through under your body, rotating onto the side of the standing foot.
Reach the lifted hand up and back.
Swing back to the bear and switch sides.
exercises.cue: A fluid rotation, pivoting on the standing foot.
exercises.avoid: Sitting down on the floor during the kick.

exercises.name: Crab walk
steps: Sit with your hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet, and lift your hips.
Walk forward on hands and feet, hips up.
Then walk backward.
Keep your hips high the whole way.
exercises.cue: Push your hips toward the ceiling.
exercises.avoid: Sagging hips.

exercises.name: Lateral bear crawl
steps: Set up a bear position, knees just off the floor.
Crawl sideways, moving the hand and foot on the same side together.
Go one length one way, then crawl back.
Stay low throughout.
exercises.cue: Knees stay an inch off the floor.
exercises.avoid: Hips rising up.

exercises.name: Lizard crawl
steps: Start at the bottom of a push-up, chest near the floor.
Crawl forward, bringing each knee up to its elbow on the same side as you reach the opposite hand forward.
Stay low throughout.
Crawl the whole length.
exercises.cue: Shoulders stay down near the floor.
exercises.avoid: Pushing up to rest.

exercises.name: Ape walk
steps: Squat down and put your hands on the floor to one side.
Shift your weight onto your hands and hop your feet sideways past them.
Land in a squat and move your hands sideways again.
Go one length each way.
exercises.cue: Stay in the squat; don't stand up between hops.
exercises.avoid: Landing with straight legs.

exercises.name: Bear crawl + push-ups
steps: Bear crawl forward 5 m.
Drop into 3 push-ups.
Bear crawl back.
Do 3 more push-ups. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Knees stay just off the floor while crawling.
exercises.avoid: Hips up in a pike when you're tired.

exercises.name: Crab walk out, sprint back
steps: Crab walk 15 m to the far end.
Flip over and sprint back.
Walk the length back as rest.
Repeat.
exercises.cue: Sprint as soon as you're on your feet.
exercises.avoid: Slowing to a jog on the sprint.

exercises.name: Waiter walk
steps: Press a kettlebell or dumbbell overhead with one arm and lock it out.
Walk with the weight straight over your shoulder.
Keep your ribs down and eyes forward.
Switch hands halfway through.
exercises.cue: Arm by your ear, biceps next to your head.
exercises.avoid: The weight drifting forward.

exercises.name: Front-rack carry
steps: Clean two kettlebells or dumbbells to your shoulders.
Hold them there, elbows down, wrists straight.
Walk with small, controlled steps.
Breathe into your belly against the weight.
exercises.cue: Stand tall; the weights will try to fold you forward.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back.

exercises.name: Mixed carry
steps: Hold one weight locked out overhead and one at your side.
Walk tall, shoulders level.
Keep both arms straight.
Switch hands halfway through.
exercises.cue: Two different jobs for two arms. The core keeps the peace.
exercises.avoid: Leaning away from the overhead weight.

exercises.name: Carry medley
steps: Farmer carry: a weight in each hand at your sides.
Clean them to your shoulders and front-rack carry.
Press them overhead and carry them locked out.
Set them down. That's one set.
exercises.cue: Change positions without putting the weights down.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the clean when your grip is fried.

exercises.name: Kettlebell halo
steps: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the horns at chest height.
Circle it around your head, close to your skull.
Bring it back to your chest.
Finish all reps, then circle the other way.
exercises.cue: Glutes and abs tight; only your arms move.
exercises.avoid: Arching your back as the bell goes behind your head.

exercises.name: Kettlebell windmill
steps: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm, feet wide, toes turned away from the bell.
Push your hips out toward the bell side and hinge down, sliding your free hand down the inside of your leg.
Eyes on the bell, arm locked, until your free hand reaches the floor or your shin.
Stand back up. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: The bell arm stays vertical like a flagpole.
exercises.avoid: Bending the bell arm.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up + windmill
steps: Do a Turkish get-up with the kettlebell locked out overhead.
At the top, standing, do a windmill.
Stand back up and reverse the get-up to lie down.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Eyes on the bell, always.
exercises.avoid: Rushing any position.

exercises.name: Cossack squat + press
steps: Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell at your chest in a wide stance.
Sit into a Cossack squat on one side.
At the bottom, press the weight overhead.
Lower it, stand up and switch sides.
exercises.cue: Stay low and steady during the press.
exercises.avoid: The bent-knee heel lifting.

exercises.name: Renegade lunge
steps: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell in each hand and step back into a reverse lunge.
At the bottom, lean your chest slightly forward and row one weight to your ribs.
Lower it and row the other.
Stand up and switch legs.
exercises.cue: Stay low and still during the rows.
exercises.avoid: Back knee resting on the floor.

exercises.name: Sandbag get-up
steps: Lie on your back with the sandbag across one shoulder.
Get up to standing any way you can without dropping the bag.
Lie back down the same way.
Finish all reps, then switch shoulders.
exercises.cue: Find a different route up each time: kneeling, lunging, rolling.
exercises.avoid: Holding your breath.

exercises.name: Grip gauntlet
steps: Dead hang from the bar.
Straight into a towel hang.
Straight into a plate pinch hold.
No rest between them.
exercises.cue: The forearms will quit before you do. Don't let them.
exercises.avoid: Dropping early; shorten the times instead.

exercises.name: Duck walk
steps: Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Walk forward staying in the squat, one small step at a time.
Keep your chest up and hands in front of you.
Walk the whole length without standing up.
exercises.cue: Stay low: your head shouldn't bob up and down.
exercises.avoid: Standing up to rest.

exercises.name: Goblet duck walk
steps: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at your chest.
Squat down and stay there.
Walk forward in the squat, small steps.
Walk the whole length without standing up.
exercises.cue: Elbows inside your knees; push them out.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back under the weight.

exercises.name: Frog jumps
steps: Squat deep, hands touching the floor between your feet.
Jump forward as far as you can, swinging your arms.
Land softly back in the deep squat, hands touching the floor.
Jump again straight away. Keep jumping in a row.
exercises.cue: Every jump starts and ends in the same deep squat.
exercises.avoid: Landing with straight legs.

exercises.name: Continuous deep squat jumps
steps: Squat deep, thighs at least parallel to the floor.
Jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly and sink straight back down into the deep squat.
Jump again without pausing at the top or bottom.
exercises.cue: The landing is the start of the next jump.
exercises.avoid: Getting shallower as you tire; fewer, deeper jumps win.

exercises.name: Lateral frog jumps
steps: Squat deep, hands touching the floor.
Jump sideways as far as you can.
Land in the deep squat, hands down.
Do all jumps one way, then come back the other way.
exercises.cue: Land with both feet at once.
exercises.avoid: Knees caving in on the landing.

exercises.name: Squat jump chain
steps: 3 continuous deep squat jumps.
Straight into 3 frog jumps forward.
Straight into 3 tuck jumps.
No pause between jumps. That's one chain.
exercises.cue: Stay springy: every landing loads the next jump.
exercises.avoid: Stopping to reset between jumps.

exercises.name: Duck walk + frog jumps
steps: Duck walk half the room, staying low.
From the squat, frog jump the rest of the way.
Walk back as rest.
Repeat.
exercises.cue: Stay low throughout; your legs never get a break.
exercises.avoid: Standing up between the walk and the jumps.

exercises.name: Frog jumps + sprint
steps: Do the frog jumps from the start line.
Land the last one and sprint the rest of the 15 m.
Slow down before the wall.
Walk back and go again.
exercises.cue: The last landing is your sprint start.
exercises.avoid: Standing up before the sprint.

exercises.name: Floor gauntlet
steps: Setup: mark the halfway point of your 15 m space.
Bear crawl to halfway.
Stand up and do 3 broad jumps.
Sprint the rest of the length, walk back. That's one run.
exercises.cue: Quality first: soft landings, low crawl.
exercises.avoid: Racing through sloppy broad jumps.

exercises.name: Animal course
steps: Duck walk 5 m.
Frog jump 5 m.
Lateral bear crawl 3 m, then sprint the rest of the length.
Walk back. That's one run.
exercises.cue: Keep moving between stations.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the frog jump landings.

exercises.name: Ground beast course
steps: Lizard crawl 5 m.
Crab walk 5 m.
Ape walk 3 m, then 3 tuck jumps.
Sprint back to the start. That's one run.
exercises.cue: The crawls will burn your shoulders; stay low anyway.
exercises.avoid: Hips high on the crawls.

exercises.name: Wall sit plate stack
steps: Hold a wall sit, thighs parallel to the floor.
Every 15 seconds, your partner lays another plate flat on your thighs, close to your hips.
When you reach the top number, hold for 15 more seconds.
Your partner takes the plates off before you stand. Switch roles.
exercises.cue: Partner: lay the plates on gently and keep your hands near them.
exercises.avoid: Standing up with the plates still on; they'll slide onto your feet.

exercises.name: Wall sit with partner pressing down
steps: Hold a wall sit, thighs parallel to the floor.
Your partner puts their hands on your thighs just above the knees and presses straight down.
Start light; the sitter says 'more' or 'less'.
Switch roles.
exercises.cue: Sitter: push your heels into the floor against the pressure.
exercises.avoid: Partner: pressing on the kneecaps. Stay on the thighs.

exercises.name: Wall sit with partner on your lap
steps: Hold a wall sit, thighs parallel to the floor.
Your partner sits carefully on your thighs near your hips, keeping their own feet on the floor.
The partner controls how much weight they give by pushing through their own feet.
Partner stands up first. Switch roles.
exercises.cue: Partner: take weight off the moment the sitter's hips start rising.
exercises.avoid: Partner sitting on the knees: sit close to the hips.

exercises.name: Wall sit + plank swap
steps: One partner holds a wall sit while the other holds a plank.
Every 30 seconds, swap positions as fast as you can.
The clock doesn't stop during the swap.
Both of you are working the whole time.
exercises.cue: Swap quickly; the slow partner costs you both.
exercises.avoid: Resting in a half-hearted plank.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded push-ups
steps: Set up a push-up.
Your partner lays a plate flat on your upper back, between your shoulder blades.
Do the push-ups with a rigid body so the plate stays put.
Your partner lifts the plate off before you drop. Switch roles.
exercises.cue: Partner: keep one hand hovering over the plate.
exercises.avoid: Plate on the lower back; it'll slide off and arches your spine.

exercises.name: Plate push-up drop set
steps: Your partner stacks two plates on your upper back.
Do 5 push-ups. Your partner takes one plate off.
Do 5 more. Your partner takes the last one off.
Do as many as you can with just your bodyweight. Switch roles.
exercises.cue: No rest while the plates come off: stay in the plank.
exercises.avoid: Letting your hips sag under the stack.

exercises.name: Partner-resisted push-ups
steps: Set up a push-up.
Your partner puts both hands flat on your upper back, between your shoulder blades.
They press down steadily as you push up; start light.
Switch roles.
exercises.cue: Partner: match the pressure to your partner's speed; smooth reps, not grinding ones.
exercises.avoid: Partner pressing on the lower back.

exercises.name: Plank plate stack
steps: Hold a forearm plank.
Every 15 seconds, your partner lays another plate on your upper back.
Hold 15 seconds at the top number.
Your partner removes them one by one before you drop. Switch roles.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes harder with every plate.
exercises.avoid: Dropping your knees with plates still on your back.

exercises.name: Bear hold with plate
steps: Hold a bear position: hands under shoulders, knees an inch off the floor, back flat.
Your partner lays a plate flat on your lower back.
Hold without letting it tilt.
Partner takes it off. Switch roles.
exercises.cue: If the plate tilts, your hips are moving.
exercises.avoid: Hips rising to escape the load.

exercises.name: Stacked plank
steps: One partner holds a high plank.
The other sets up a high plank facing the same way, with their feet on the bottom partner's shoulders.
Both hold. Talk to each other.
Top partner steps down carefully. Switch places.
exercises.cue: Bottom partner: shoulders stacked over hands, arms locked.
exercises.avoid: Top partner's feet on the lower back; keep them on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Glute bridge plate stack
steps: Hold a glute bridge, hips high.
Every 15 seconds, your partner lays a plate across your hips.
Hold 15 seconds at the top number.
Your partner takes the plates off before you lower. Switch roles.
exercises.cue: Drive through your heels and squeeze.
exercises.avoid: Hips sinking as the stack grows.

exercises.name: Weighted reverse plank
steps: Sit with your legs straight and a plate resting flat on your hips, held with one hand.
Put your hands on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Lift your hips until your body is a straight line from heels to shoulders, keeping the plate balanced on your hips.
Hold, then sit back down before taking the plate off. Bend your knees into a tabletop to make it easier.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes to keep the hips up under the plate.
exercises.avoid: Letting your head drop back; look at your toes.

exercises.name: Weighted glute bridge hold
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, a plate resting on your hips.
Hold the plate in place with both hands.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips into a bridge.
Hold at the top, then lower before removing the plate.
exercises.cue: Push your knees slightly out and squeeze.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back instead of using your glutes.

exercises.name: Weighted hollow hold
steps: Lie on your back holding a light plate with straight arms above your chest.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs.
Move the plate back toward your head until you feel your abs working hard.
Hold the banana shape.
exercises.cue: The further back the plate goes, the harder it gets.
exercises.avoid: Lower back peeling off the floor; bring the plate forward if it does.

exercises.name: Jump rope
steps: Hold the handles at hip height, elbows close to your sides.
Turn the rope with your wrists, not your arms.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope, landing on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm; if you trip, start again straight away.
exercises.cue: Small, quiet jumps: an inch off the floor is enough.
exercises.avoid: Big arm circles and high, heavy jumps.

exercises.name: Jump rope, alternate feet
steps: Turn the rope as for the basic jump.
Step over it one foot at a time, like jogging in place.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Speed up as you get comfortable.
exercises.cue: Quick feet, relaxed shoulders.
exercises.avoid: Kicking your heels back so the rope catches them.

exercises.name: Jump rope high knees
steps: Turn the rope in an alternate-foot rhythm.
Drive each knee up to hip height as it passes the rope.
Keep the rope turning fast.
Stay tall; don't lean back.
exercises.cue: Knees up, rope fast, chest proud.
exercises.avoid: Slowing the rope to fit the knees in.

exercises.name: Jump rope skier hops
steps: Turn the rope in a basic rhythm.
Hop side to side over an imaginary line, feet together.
Keep the hops small and quick.
Keep your shoulders square to the front.
exercises.cue: Your feet move, your upper body stays still.
exercises.avoid: Hopping so wide the rope can't keep up.

exercises.name: Single-leg jump rope
steps: Turn the rope in a basic rhythm.
Lift one foot and skip on the other only.
Stay on the ball of the foot, knee soft.
Switch legs halfway through.
exercises.cue: Short ground contacts, like a pogo stick.
exercises.avoid: Landing flat-footed.

exercises.name: Double-under practice
steps: Do three basic jumps to set a rhythm.
On the fourth, jump a little higher and flick your wrists twice as fast so the rope passes twice.
Go straight back into three basic jumps.
One round is three singles and one double-under.
exercises.cue: Jump height stays nearly the same; the wrists do the extra work.
exercises.avoid: Piking your legs forward on the double.

exercises.name: Double-unders
steps: Jump and pass the rope under your feet twice in one jump.
Keep your elbows by your sides and spin from the wrists.
Keep your body straight in the air, toes pointed slightly down.
Link them together without singles in between.
exercises.cue: A relaxed rhythm beats fighting the rope.
exercises.avoid: Donkey-kicking your feet back.

exercises.name: Criss-cross jumps
steps: Jump rope with a basic rhythm.
On one jump, cross your arms in front of your body so the rope makes a loop.
Jump through the loop, then uncross on the next jump.
Keep alternating open and crossed.
exercises.cue: Cross your arms deep, hands past your hips.
exercises.avoid: Crossing only at the wrists; the loop gets too small.

exercises.name: Triple-unders
steps: Jump higher than for a double-under.
Spin the rope three times under your feet before landing.
Land softly and reset.
Link them if you can.
exercises.cue: Maximum wrist speed, minimum arm movement.
exercises.avoid: Tucking your knees up; stay straight.

exercises.name: Jump rope speed burst
steps: Jump rope with alternate feet as fast as you possibly can.
Count every time your right foot lands.
Try to beat your count on the next set.
Rest completely between sets.
exercises.cue: It's a sprint on the spot.
exercises.avoid: Letting the form fall apart; slow down a touch if you keep tripping.

exercises.name: Low-squat jump rope
steps: Sink into a half squat, thighs close to parallel.
Jump rope while staying in the squat.
Keep your chest up and the jumps tiny.
Don't stand up until the time's up.
exercises.cue: Your legs will burn; stay low anyway.
exercises.avoid: Rising up out of the squat as you tire.

exercises.name: Jump rope + burpees
steps: Jump rope for the time.
Drop the rope and do the burpees.
Pick up the rope and go again straight away.
Rest only when all rounds are done.
exercises.cue: Keep the rope right next to you so there's no walking.
exercises.avoid: Tripping over the rope during burpees; lay it out to the side.

exercises.name: Jump rope + squat jumps
steps: Jump rope for the time.
Drop the rope and do the squat jumps, landing softly.
Pick up the rope and go again.
Rest only when all rounds are done.
exercises.cue: Small jumps on the rope, maximum height on the squat jumps.
exercises.avoid: Stiff landings on the squat jumps.

exercises.name: Double-unders + push-ups
steps: Do the double-unders.
Drop the rope and do the push-ups.
Straight back to the rope.
Rest only when all rounds are done.
exercises.cue: Breathe in the plank before the push-ups; your heart will be racing.
exercises.avoid: Sloppy half push-ups.

exercises.name: Jump rope + plank
steps: Jump rope for the time.
Drop straight into a forearm plank.
Get up and pick up the rope.
Rest only when all rounds are done.
exercises.cue: Slow your breathing down in the plank.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging while you catch your breath.

exercises.name: Jump rope + kettlebell swings
steps: Jump rope for the time.
Drop the rope and do the kettlebell swings.
Park the bell and pick up the rope.
Rest only when all rounds are done.
exercises.cue: Snap your hips on every swing, even when you're breathing hard.
exercises.avoid: Squatting the swing instead of hinging.

exercises.name: Jump rope + 15 m sprint
steps: Jump rope at the start line.
Drop the rope and sprint the 15 m.
Walk back to the rope; that's your rest.
Repeat.
exercises.cue: Quick feet on the rope, then turn them into speed.
exercises.avoid: Easing into the sprint.

exercises.name: Two in one rope
steps: Stand face to face, close together. One partner turns the rope.
Jump together in the same rhythm.
Count out loud to stay in time.
Swap who turns halfway.
exercises.cue: Jump small and together; one big jumper trips you both.
exercises.avoid: Standing too far apart.

exercises.name: Jump rope burpee relay
steps: One partner jumps rope for 30 seconds while the other does burpees.
Swap without resting.
That's one round.
Count your team's total burpees.
exercises.cue: Burpees while your partner skips; no standing around.
exercises.avoid: Resting during the rope part.

exercises.name: Rope-run course
steps: Setup: mark the halfway point of your 15 m space and lay the rope at the start.
Run-skip with the rope to halfway, turning it as you run.
Drop the rope and do 3 broad jumps.
Sprint to the end, walk back and collect the rope. That's one run.
exercises.cue: Keep the rope turning fast while you run.
exercises.avoid: Tripping on the rope; slow down until the running rhythm is smooth.

exercises.name: Weighted vest push-ups
steps: Put the vest on and tighten it so it doesn't shift.
Set up a push-up, body in one straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press back up.
exercises.cue: Everything stays tight; the vest punishes sagging hips.
exercises.avoid: The vest hanging loose and swinging.

exercises.name: Weighted vest pull-ups
steps: Put on the vest and hang from the bar.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
Keep your legs still.
exercises.cue: Pull your elbows down into your back pockets.
exercises.avoid: Kipping; the vest makes swinging harder on your shoulders.

exercises.name: Weighted vest dips
steps: Put on the vest and support yourself on parallettes or rings, arms locked.
Lower until your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Press back up to locked arms.
Lean forward slightly throughout.
exercises.cue: Shoulders down, away from your ears.
exercises.avoid: Dropping too deep if your shoulders complain.

exercises.name: Weighted vest chest-to-bar hold
steps: Put on the vest and grab the bar.
Pull up until your chest touches the bar.
Hold it there, elbows tight.
Lower as slowly as you can when time's up.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the bar hard; grip helps everything else.
exercises.avoid: Kicking to stay up.

exercises.name: Weighted vest dead hang
steps: Put on the vest and hang from the bar, arms straight.
Shoulders slightly engaged, not fully relaxed.
Legs still.
Drop off before your grip fails completely.
exercises.cue: Grip as if you're trying to crush the bar.
exercises.avoid: Letting your shoulders hang completely loose.

exercises.name: Weighted vest squats
steps: Put on the vest and stand with feet shoulder-width.
Squat down to at least parallel, chest up.
Stand up tall.
Keep a steady pace.
exercises.cue: Weight in your whole foot.
exercises.avoid: Heels lifting.

exercises.name: Weighted vest pistol squat
steps: Put on the vest and stand on one leg, the other straight out in front.
Squat all the way down on the standing leg.
Stand back up without touching down.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Reach your arms forward for balance.
exercises.avoid: Collapsing at the bottom; pause and stand slowly.

exercises.name: Weighted vest walking lunges
steps: Put on the vest.
Step forward into a lunge until your back knee is just off the floor.
Drive up and step straight into the next lunge.
Walk the length of the room and back.
exercises.cue: Tall torso, long steps.
exercises.avoid: Back knee slamming down.

exercises.name: Weighted vest step-ups
steps: Put on the vest and stand facing a box or bench.
Step up with one foot and drive through that heel to stand on top.
Step down slowly with the same leg.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: The top leg does the work; don't push off the back foot.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving in on the step up.

exercises.name: Weighted vest single-leg RDL
steps: Put on the vest and stand on one leg.
Hinge forward, the free leg reaching back, until your body is nearly parallel to the floor.
Stand back up by squeezing the glute of the standing leg.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Hips stay square to the floor.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to reach lower.

exercises.name: Weighted vest wall sit
steps: Put on the vest and set up a wall sit, thighs parallel to the floor.
Press your whole back into the wall.
Arms off your legs.
Hold.
exercises.cue: Push your heels into the floor.
exercises.avoid: Hips creeping up the wall.

exercises.name: Weighted vest plank
steps: Put on the vest and set up a forearm plank.
Straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Hold.
exercises.cue: Push the floor away with your forearms.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging under the vest.

exercises.name: Weighted vest bear crawl
steps: Put on the vest and get into a bear position, knees an inch off the floor.
Crawl forward, moving opposite hand and foot together.
Keep your back flat.
Crawl the length and back.
exercises.cue: Knees stay low the whole way.
exercises.avoid: Hips rising up.

exercises.name: Weighted vest duck walk
steps: Put on the vest and squat down, thighs at least parallel.
Walk forward in the squat, small steps.
Keep your chest up.
Walk the whole length without standing up.
exercises.cue: Stay low; your head shouldn't bob up and down.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back under the vest.

exercises.name: Weighted vest farmer carry
steps: Put on the vest and pick up a heavy weight in each hand.
Stand tall, shoulders back.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Set the weights down before your grip gives out.
exercises.cue: The vest makes you want to lean forward; stand taller.
exercises.avoid: Shuffling with a rounded back.

exercises.name: Weighted vest burpees
steps: Put on a light vest.
Squat, kick back to a plank, chest to the floor.
Push up, jump your feet in and jump up with arms overhead.
Land softly and go straight into the next rep.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: Belly-flopping onto the vest; lower your chest under control.

exercises.name: Weighted vest sprints
steps: Put on a light vest and tighten it well.
Sprint the 15 m.
Slow down before the wall.
Walk back and go again.
exercises.cue: Lean forward and drive your arms; the vest adds resistance to every step.
exercises.avoid: A loose vest bouncing on your chest.

exercises.name: Weighted vest box jumps
steps: Put on a light vest and use a lower box than usual.
Swing your arms and jump onto the box, landing softly in a quarter squat.
Stand up fully on top.
Step down; don't jump down with the vest on.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: Jumping down; the extra weight is hard on your Achilles.

exercises.name: Weighted vest broad jumps
steps: Put on a light vest.
Swing your arms back and hinge into a half squat.
Jump forward as far as you can.
Stick the landing, then reset.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: Landing with stiff legs.

exercises.name: Weighted vest frog jumps
steps: Put on a light vest and squat deep, hands touching the floor.
Jump forward as far as you can.
Land back in the deep squat, hands down.
Jump again straight away.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: Getting shallow as you tire.

exercises.name: Weighted vest double-unders
steps: Put on a light vest and tighten it well.
Do double-unders: the rope passes twice under your feet each jump.
Keep the jumps as low as you can.
Break the set into smaller chunks if you trip.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: The vest bouncing; if it moves, tighten it.

exercises.name: Mini Murph
steps: Put on the vest.
5 pull-ups.
10 push-ups.
15 squats. That's one round; no rest between rounds.
exercises.cue: Break the push-ups into smaller sets early, before you need to.
exercises.avoid: Letting the squats get shallow.

exercises.name: Weighted vest sprint + burpees
steps: Put on a light vest.
Do the burpees at the start line.
Sprint the 15 m.
Walk back and go again.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: Slow, sloppy burpees before the sprint.

exercises.name: Weighted vest floor gauntlet
steps: Put on the vest. Mark the halfway point of your 15 m space.
Bear crawl to halfway.
Do 3 frog jumps.
Sprint the rest of the length, walk back. That's one run.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: Racing through sloppy frog jump landings.

exercises.name: Sandbag RDL
steps: Hold the sandbag by its handles in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back, sliding the bag down your legs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
exercises.cue: Hips back, not down.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to reach lower.

exercises.name: Sandbag bent-over row
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding the bag by its handles at arm's length.
Row it to your belly, elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower under control.
exercises.cue: Keep the hinge; don't stand up as you row.
exercises.avoid: Jerking the bag with your back.

exercises.name: Sandbag Zercher squat
steps: Cradle the sandbag in the crooks of your elbows, hands together at your chest.
Squat down to at least parallel, chest up.
Drive up through your whole foot.
Keep the bag tight to your body.
exercises.cue: Elbows up and the bag high; it pulls your chest forward.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bag sag to your belly.

exercises.name: Sandbag overhead press
steps: Hold the sandbag by its handles, or on top of your palms, at your chest.
Press it straight overhead until your arms lock.
Lower it back to your chest under control.
Squeeze your glutes to protect your lower back.
exercises.cue: The shifting sand makes every rep different; stay tight.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to finish the press.

exercises.name: Sandbag floor press
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, the sandbag on your chest held by its handles.
Press it straight up until your arms lock.
Lower until your elbows touch the floor.
Press again.
exercises.cue: Keep both arms working evenly; the sand will slide to the weaker side.
exercises.avoid: Dropping the bag onto your chest.

exercises.name: Sandbag lateral lunge
steps: Hold the sandbag in a Zercher or bear-hug position.
Step wide to one side and sit into that hip, the other leg straight.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Sit back into the hip, heel down.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving inward.

exercises.name: Sandbag reverse lunge + rotation
steps: Hold the sandbag at your chest in a bear hug.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
At the bottom, rotate your chest and the bag toward the front leg.
Rotate back, stand up and switch legs.
exercises.cue: The front knee stays still while your chest turns.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the rotation.

exercises.name: Sandbag clean
steps: Stand over the sandbag lying on the floor, grab it by the sides.
Hinge and pull it off the floor, then explode your hips forward.
Pull it up your body and catch it in a bear hug at your chest, dropping into a half squat.
Stand up, then lower it back to the floor.
exercises.cue: It's a jump with the bag, not an arm curl.
exercises.avoid: Pulling with a round back.

exercises.name: Sandbag drag
steps: Grab the sandbag by one end and walk backward, low in a half squat.
Drag it the whole length.
Keep your chest up and arms long.
Turn around and drag it back.
exercises.cue: Push through your legs; your arms just hold on.
exercises.avoid: Standing up tall and dragging with your lower back.

exercises.name: Sandbag plank drag-through
steps: Set up a high plank with the sandbag just outside one hand.
Reach under your body with the far hand, grab the bag and drag it to the other side.
Put that hand back down and repeat with the other hand.
Keep your hips still.
exercises.cue: Feet wide for stability.
exercises.avoid: Hips swinging as you reach.

exercises.name: Sandbag Zercher carry
steps: Cradle the bag in the crooks of your elbows.
Stand tall, bag high on your chest.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Set it down before your arms give out.
exercises.cue: Breathe into your belly against the bag.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to hold it up.

exercises.name: Sandbag shoulder carry
steps: Clean the bag to your chest and pop it onto one shoulder.
Stand tall and walk.
Don't let the bag pull you sideways.
Switch shoulders halfway through.
exercises.cue: Brace as if someone is about to push you over.
exercises.avoid: Leaning away from the bag.

exercises.name: Sandbag chest throw and chase
steps: Hold the bag at your chest and squat slightly.
Explode up and throw it forward as far as you can.
Run to it, pick it up and throw again.
Keep going to the end of the lane and back.
exercises.cue: Legs first, arms last.
exercises.avoid: Throwing from a round back when picking it up.

exercises.name: Sandbag lateral toss
steps: Stand side-on to the throwing direction, bag held at your back hip.
Rotate explosively and throw it sideways as far as you can.
Walk to it, pick it up and throw from the other side.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: The power comes from your hips turning.
exercises.avoid: Throwing with just your arms.

exercises.name: Sandbag burpee jump-over
steps: Lay the sandbag lengthwise beside you.
Do a burpee next to it.
Jump sideways over the bag with both feet.
Burpee on the other side and jump back.
exercises.cue: Land softly and go straight down.
exercises.avoid: Clipping the bag with your feet.

exercises.name: Sandbag burpee + clean
steps: Do a burpee with your chest on the sandbag.
Jump your feet in beside the bag.
Clean the bag to your chest and stand up.
Drop it and go straight into the next burpee.
exercises.cue: Hinge for the clean, even when you're gassed.
exercises.avoid: Round-back cleans when tired.

exercises.name: Sandbag carry medley
steps: Bear-hug carry.
Shift the bag into your elbows for a Zercher carry.
Pop it onto a shoulder for a shoulder carry.
Set it down. That's one set.
exercises.cue: Change positions without putting the bag down.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the transitions.

exercises.name: Sandbag complex
steps: 5 sandbag cleans.
5 Zercher squats.
5 overhead presses.
5 reverse lunges on each leg, then a 15 m drag. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Pick a bag you can press 5 times when you're tired.
exercises.avoid: Heavy bags; this is a conditioning complex.

exercises.name: Partner sandbag chest toss
steps: Stand about 3 m from your partner.
Throw the sandbag to them from your chest, two-handed.
They catch it at their chest, absorb it with a small squat and throw it back.
Keep a steady rhythm.
exercises.cue: Catch it with soft arms and legs.
exercises.avoid: Throwing at your partner's head.

exercises.name: Side-to-side slams
steps: Lift the ball overhead.
Slam it down beside the outside of one foot, rotating your chest toward it.
Pick it up, bring it overhead and slam beside the other foot.
Keep alternating.
exercises.cue: Pivot your back foot so your hips turn too.
exercises.avoid: Twisting through your lower back with stiff hips.

exercises.name: Kneeling slams
steps: Kneel tall on a mat, ball overhead.
Slam it into the floor in front of your knees with everything you've got.
Pick it up and bring it straight back overhead.
Stay tall on your knees.
exercises.cue: Your legs can't help, so it's all abs and lats.
exercises.avoid: Sitting back on your heels.

exercises.name: Jumping slams
steps: Hold the ball overhead.
Jump straight up, reaching as high as you can.
On the way down, slam the ball as you land.
Pick it up and go again.
exercises.cue: Time the slam with the landing.
exercises.avoid: Landing with stiff legs.

exercises.name: Ball chest throw and chase
steps: Hold the ball at your chest and squat slightly.
Throw it forward and slightly up as far as you can.
Run to it, pick it up and throw again.
Keep going to the end of the lane and back.
exercises.cue: Push through your legs as you throw.
exercises.avoid: Throwing with bent, lazy arms.

exercises.name: Backward overhead toss
steps: Face away from your lane, the ball between your legs, knees bent.
Explode up, extending your hips, and throw the ball backward over your head as far as you can.
Turn, walk to the ball and bring it back to the line.
Check your lane is clear before every throw.
exercises.cue: Full hip extension, like a jump.
exercises.avoid: Throwing with your arms and back.

exercises.name: Slam ball clean + squat
steps: Squat down and grab the ball from the floor.
Explode up and pop it to your chest.
Squat with the ball at your chest.
Stand up and lower it back to the floor.
exercises.cue: The clean is a jump; the squat is controlled.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to pick it up.

exercises.name: Slam + burpee
steps: Slam the ball.
Put your hands on the ball, jump back into a plank and do a push-up.
Jump in, pick up the ball and bring it overhead.
Slam again.
exercises.cue: Hands on the ball make the push-up wobble; keep it tight.
exercises.avoid: Sloppy burpees to get to the next slam.

exercises.name: Ball Russian twist
steps: Sit with knees bent, holding the ball at your chest.
Lean back until your abs switch on; lift your feet to make it harder.
Touch the ball to the floor on one side, then the other.
Keep your back long.
exercises.cue: Turn your chest, not just your arms.
exercises.avoid: Slumping.

exercises.name: Ball V-up pass
steps: Lie on your back holding the ball overhead.
Do a V-up and pass the ball from your hands to between your feet.
Lower down with the ball between your feet.
V-up again and take it back into your hands. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the ball hard with your feet.
exercises.avoid: Dropping the ball on your face.

exercises.name: Ball roll-over push-ups
steps: Set up a push-up with one hand on the ball.
Do a push-up.
Roll the ball to the other hand.
Push-up with the other hand on the ball. Keep alternating.
exercises.cue: Tight body; the ball will wobble.
exercises.avoid: Hips twisting as the ball moves.

exercises.name: Slam ball complex
steps: 5 slam ball cleans + squats.
5 overhead slams.
5 side-to-side slams each side.
5 slam + burpees. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Keep the ball moving; no putting it down.
exercises.avoid: Letting the slams go soft when you're tired.

exercises.name: Throw-and-chase gauntlet
steps: Throw the ball forward from your chest.
Sprint to it, do a burpee next to it.
Pick it up, slam it once, then throw it forward again.
Keep going the whole length of the lane.
exercises.cue: Every throw, sprint and burpee at full effort.
exercises.avoid: Throwing short to make the sprints easier.

exercises.name: Overhead forward throw
steps: Stand at the start of your lane, holding the ball overhead with both hands.
Step forward and throw it as far as you can, like a football throw-in.
Walk or jog to the ball and bring it back.
Alternate your stepping foot.
exercises.cue: Whip from your abs; the arms finish the throw.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back to wind up.

exercises.name: Scoop toss for distance
steps: Hold the ball between your legs, arms long, in a half squat.
Explode up and throw the ball forward and up with straight arms.
Let the jump carry you forward a step.
Fetch the ball and go again.
exercises.cue: It's a jump that happens to throw a ball.
exercises.avoid: Throwing with bent arms and no legs.

exercises.name: Medicine ball shot put
steps: Stand side-on to a wall, ball at your shoulder in one hand, the other hand supporting it.
Rotate your hips and push the ball explosively at the wall, like a shot put.
Catch it on the rebound or pick it up.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Hips first, then chest, then arm.
exercises.avoid: Throwing with a bent wrist.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling rotational throw
steps: Kneel side-on to a wall, inside knee up, ball at your back hip.
Rotate and throw the ball hard against the wall.
Catch it and rotate straight back to load the next throw.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Kneeling locks your legs; your trunk does the work.
exercises.avoid: Leaning away from the wall.

exercises.name: Sit-up + wall throw
steps: Sit facing a wall about a metre away, knees bent, ball on your chest.
Lie back with the ball overhead.
Sit up and throw the ball at the wall as you rise.
Catch it, lie back down and repeat.
exercises.cue: Throw at the top of the sit-up, using your whole torso.
exercises.avoid: Pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: Medicine ball woodchop
steps: Hold the ball above one shoulder, arms long.
Chop it diagonally across your body to the outside of the opposite knee, squatting slightly.
Drive it back up the same line.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Pivot your back foot so your hips turn.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Medicine ball pressing dead bug
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Hold the ball between one hand and the opposite knee, pressing them together hard.
Straighten the free arm and leg toward the floor.
Bring them back. Finish all reps, then switch the ball to the other side.
exercises.cue: Press the ball hard; it switches your abs on.
exercises.avoid: Lower back lifting off the floor.

exercises.name: Hands-on-ball push-up
steps: Put both hands on the medicine ball, fingers spread.
Set up a push-up with feet a bit wider than usual.
Lower your chest to the ball.
Press back up.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the ball with your hands to keep it still.
exercises.avoid: Elbows flaring out wide.

exercises.name: Plank ball pass
steps: Set up a high plank with the ball beside one hand.
Pick it up and roll or pass it to the other hand without moving your hips.
Pass it back.
Keep your body dead still.
exercises.cue: Feet wide makes it steadier.
exercises.avoid: Hips swaying as the ball moves.

exercises.name: Overhead medicine ball lunge
steps: Hold the ball overhead, arms straight.
Step forward into a lunge.
Drive back up.
Alternate legs.
exercises.cue: Arms by your ears, ribs down.
exercises.avoid: Letting the ball drift forward.

exercises.name: Squat jump + chest throw
steps: Hold the ball at your chest in a half squat.
Jump forward and up and throw the ball forward as far as you can at the top.
Land softly.
Fetch the ball and go again.
exercises.cue: Throw at the peak of the jump.
exercises.avoid: Throwing before your legs finish the push.

exercises.name: Burpee + chest pass
steps: Stand facing a wall with the ball.
Put the ball down and do a burpee.
Pick up the ball and throw a hard chest pass at the wall.
Catch it and go again.
exercises.cue: Explode into the pass out of the burpee.
exercises.avoid: Soft, lazy passes.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge + rotational throw
steps: Stand side-on to a wall with the ball.
Step away from the wall into a lateral lunge, loading the ball at your outside hip.
Push back and throw the ball hard at the wall as you rotate.
Catch it. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: The push off the floor powers the throw.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving in on the lunge.

exercises.name: Medicine ball complex
steps: 5 wall balls.
5 rotational throws each side.
5 chest passes.
5 burpee + chest passes. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Every throw as hard as the first.
exercises.avoid: Letting the throws go soft.

exercises.name: Partner overhead throw
steps: Stand about 4 m apart.
Throw the ball overhead to your partner, stepping into the throw.
Catch it overhead, absorbing it with your arms and a small step back.
Throw straight back.
exercises.cue: Catch high and soft.
exercises.avoid: Throwing low where your partner can't catch overhead.

exercises.name: Partner squat + chest pass
steps: Face your partner about 3 m apart.
Squat down holding the ball at your chest.
Stand up and chest-pass the ball to your partner.
They catch it, squat and pass it back.
exercises.cue: Pass as you stand, using your legs.
exercises.avoid: Half squats.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
steps: Stand with the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge down, back flat, and grab the handle with both hands.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
Lower it back to the floor under control.
exercises.cue: Push the floor away with your feet.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to reach the bell.

exercises.name: One-arm kettlebell swing
steps: Hike the bell back between your legs with one hand.
Snap your hips forward to float it to chest height.
Let it fall back between your legs and repeat.
Finish all reps, then switch hands.
exercises.cue: Keep your shoulders square; the bell wants to twist you.
exercises.avoid: Lifting the bell with your arm.

exercises.name: Dead-stop swings
steps: Set the bell a foot in front of you on the floor.
Hike it back hard and swing it up to chest height.
Let it swing back and park it on the floor in front of you.
Reset your grip and go again.
exercises.cue: Every rep starts from zero, so every hip snap must be violent.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to park the bell.

exercises.name: Hand-to-hand swing
steps: Start a one-arm swing.
At the top, when the bell floats, let go and catch it with the other hand.
Swing it back through and switch again at the top.
Keep a steady rhythm.
exercises.cue: Switch at the float, never at the bottom.
exercises.avoid: Grabbing for the bell; practise with a light one.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean
steps: Hike the bell back between your legs with one hand.
Snap your hips and pull the bell close to your body.
Let it roll around your hand into the rack position at your shoulder, wrist straight.
Drop it back between your legs. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Zip up a jacket: keep the bell close.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bell flip and bang your forearm.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean and press
steps: Clean the bell to your shoulder.
Press it straight overhead until your arm locks.
Lower it to the rack, then drop it back between your legs.
Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes before every press.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to finish the press.

exercises.name: Kettlebell push press
steps: Hold the bell in the rack position at your shoulder.
Dip your knees slightly, then drive up hard with your legs.
Use that drive to press the bell overhead.
Lower it to the rack. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Quick dip, fast drive.
exercises.avoid: Dipping too deep, like a squat.

exercises.name: Kettlebell jerk
steps: Hold the bell in the rack.
Dip and drive the bell up.
Drop under it with a second quick dip, catching it with a locked arm.
Stand up tall. Lower to the rack. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Two dips: one to drive, one to get under.
exercises.avoid: Pressing it out instead of catching it locked.

exercises.name: Kettlebell sumo high pull
steps: Stand wide with toes out, bell between your feet.
Squat down and grab the handle with both hands.
Drive up and pull the bell to chest height, elbows high.
Lower it back down under control.
exercises.cue: Legs start it, arms finish it.
exercises.avoid: Pulling with a round back.

exercises.name: Gorilla row
steps: Stand wide with two kettlebells between your feet, hinge forward with a flat back.
Grab both handles.
Row one bell to your hip while pressing the other into the floor.
Lower it and row the other side. Keep alternating.
exercises.cue: The bell on the floor is your anchor; push it down.
exercises.avoid: Twisting your torso to help the row.

exercises.name: Kettlebell floor press
steps: Lie on your back, one kettlebell in the rack position above your chest.
Press it straight up until your arm locks.
Lower until your elbow touches the floor.
Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Wrist straight, knuckles to the ceiling.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bell tip your wrist back.

exercises.name: Kettlebell pullover
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding the bell by the horns above your chest.
Lower it back behind your head with slightly bent arms.
Stop when your lower back wants to arch.
Pull it back over your chest.
exercises.cue: Ribs down the whole time.
exercises.avoid: Arching your back to get more range.

exercises.name: Double kettlebell front squat
steps: Clean two kettlebells to the rack position.
Squat down to at least parallel, elbows inside your knees.
Drive up through your whole foot.
Keep the bells tight to your chest.
exercises.cue: Chest proud; the bells try to fold you forward.
exercises.avoid: Elbows drifting away from your body.

exercises.name: Racked kettlebell reverse lunge
steps: Hold one or two kettlebells in the rack position.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
Drive back up through the front foot.
Alternate legs. With one bell, switch sides halfway through.
exercises.cue: Tall torso; the bells sit on your forearms, not your wrists.
exercises.avoid: Leaning forward under the weight.

exercises.name: Kettlebell around the world
steps: Stand tall with the kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Pass it around your body from hand to hand behind your back.
Keep your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch direction.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes; only your arms move.
exercises.avoid: Swaying your hips with the bell.

exercises.name: Kettlebell figure-8s
steps: Stand in a half squat, feet wide, bell in one hand.
Pass it between your legs from front to back to the other hand.
Bring it around the outside of that leg and pass it back through.
Keep weaving a figure 8.
exercises.cue: Keep your back flat and your hips low.
exercises.avoid: Standing up between passes.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swings + burpees
steps: Do the kettlebell swings.
Park the bell and do the burpees.
Pick the bell straight back up.
Rest only when all rounds are done.
exercises.cue: Every swing snaps, even when you're breathing hard.
exercises.avoid: Squatting the swings when tired.

exercises.name: Armor building complex
steps: With two kettlebells: 2 double cleans.
1 double press overhead.
3 double front squats.
That's one round. Rest briefly between rounds.
exercises.cue: Pick bells you can press once when you're tired.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the cleans; keep them tight.

exercises.name: Kettlebell flow
steps: Clean one kettlebell to your shoulder.
Front squat with it.
Press it overhead, then reverse lunge with it overhead.
Lower it and swing into the next clean. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: One smooth flow: never put the bell down.
exercises.avoid: Losing the overhead lockout in the lunge.

exercises.name: Kettlebell snatch + overhead lunge
steps: Snatch the bell from between your legs to overhead in one move.
With the bell locked out overhead, step back into a reverse lunge.
Stand up.
Drop the bell back between your legs. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Eyes forward, arm by your ear.
exercises.avoid: Bending the overhead arm in the lunge.

exercises.name: Kettlebell bent press
steps: Clean the bell to your shoulder and stand with feet wide.
Keep your arm still and bend your body away and under the bell, like a windmill.
When your arm is locked, stand up under the bell.
Lower it carefully. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: The arm doesn't press; your body moves under it.
exercises.avoid: Rushing; this is an old-time strongman lift built on patience.

exercises.name: Dumbbell snatch
steps: Stand over a dumbbell, feet hip-width. Squat and grab it with one hand.
Explode up through your legs and hips, pulling the dumbbell close to your body.
Punch it straight overhead in one move, arm locked.
Lower it to your shoulder, then to the floor. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Legs and hips throw it; the arm just guides it up.
exercises.avoid: Curling the weight up with your arm.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hang clean
steps: Hold two dumbbells at your sides, hinge slightly so they hang at your knees.
Snap your hips forward and shrug.
Drop under slightly and catch the dumbbells on your shoulders, elbows forward.
Lower them back to the hang.
exercises.cue: Jump the weights up; don't curl them.
exercises.avoid: Swinging the dumbbells out in front of you.

exercises.name: Dumbbell cluster
steps: Hold two dumbbells at your sides.
Clean them to your shoulders.
Drop straight into a front squat.
Drive up and press them overhead in one motion. Lower them and repeat.
exercises.cue: Clean, squat, press: one fluid movement.
exercises.avoid: Pausing between the parts.

exercises.name: Curl + press
steps: Hold two dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl them to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms forward and press them overhead.
Lower back to your shoulders, then to your sides.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes during the press.
exercises.avoid: Swinging your hips to get the curl up.

exercises.name: Arnold press
steps: Hold two dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Lock out overhead.
Reverse the rotation as you lower.
exercises.cue: Smooth rotation throughout.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Z press
steps: Sit on the floor with legs straight out in front, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit tall without leaning back.
Press both dumbbells overhead.
Lower under control.
exercises.cue: No legs to help, so your core does all the stabilising.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to finish the press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell push press
steps: Hold two dumbbells at your shoulders.
Dip your knees slightly, then drive up hard with your legs.
Use that drive to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them back to your shoulders.
exercises.cue: Quick dip, fast drive.
exercises.avoid: Dipping too deep, like a squat.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell overhead squat
steps: Press one dumbbell overhead and lock your arm.
Squat as deep as you can, keeping the dumbbell stacked over your shoulder.
Stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.cue: Eyes forward, arm by your ear.
exercises.avoid: Letting the weight drift forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell step-up + knee drive
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, facing a box or bench.
Step up with one foot and drive the other knee up to hip height at the top.
Step down slowly with the knee-drive leg.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: The top leg does the work.
exercises.avoid: Pushing off the back foot.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian split squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and rest the top of your back foot on a bench.
Lower until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive back up through the front heel.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Front shin roughly vertical.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing off the back foot.

exercises.name: Offset reverse lunge
steps: Hold one dumbbell at your shoulder, on the same side as the leg that will step back.
Step back into a reverse lunge without leaning toward the weight.
Drive back up.
Finish all reps, then switch the weight and the leg.
exercises.cue: The uneven load makes your core work against leaning.
exercises.avoid: Tilting toward the weight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral lunge
steps: Hold a dumbbell at your chest (goblet) or one in each hand.
Step wide to one side and sit into that hip, the other leg straight.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Sit back, heel down.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving in.

exercises.name: Dumbbell sumo squat
steps: Stand wide with toes out, holding one dumbbell vertically by its top end between your legs.
Squat down, knees tracking over your toes.
Let the dumbbell reach close to the floor.
Drive up and squeeze your glutes.
exercises.cue: Push your knees out.
exercises.avoid: Leaning forward.

exercises.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
steps: Set the bench to an incline, or lie face down on a flat bench, a dumbbell in each hand.
Let the dumbbells hang straight down.
Row them to your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Chest stays glued to the bench.
exercises.avoid: Lifting your chest to cheat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
steps: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell by its end above your chest.
Lower it back behind your head with slightly bent arms.
Stop when you feel a deep stretch in your lats.
Pull it back over your chest.
exercises.cue: Ribs stay down.
exercises.avoid: Arching your back to get more range.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench, a dumbbell across your hips.
Plant your feet, knees bent.
Drive your hips up until your body is level, chin tucked.
Squeeze at the top, then lower.
exercises.cue: Push through your heels.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back instead of squeezing your glutes.

exercises.name: Dumbbell burpee deadlift
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand.
Squat and put the dumbbells on the floor, jump back into a plank on the handles.
Jump your feet back in.
Deadlift the dumbbells to standing.
exercises.cue: Flat back on the deadlift, even when tired.
exercises.avoid: Crashing onto the dumbbells in the plank.

exercises.name: Dumbbell complex
steps: With two dumbbells and without putting them down: 6 Romanian deadlifts.
6 bent-over rows.
6 hang cleans.
6 front squats, then 6 push presses. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Pick a weight you can push press 6 times when you're tired.
exercises.avoid: Racing through the rows.

exercises.name: Pull-up with a dumbbell between your feet
steps: Grip the bar and squeeze a dumbbell between your feet (or cross your ankles over it).
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
Set the dumbbell down carefully when you finish.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your legs hard so the dumbbell doesn't slip.
exercises.avoid: Kipping; the extra weight is hard on your shoulders.

exercises.name: Farmer walking lunge
steps: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward into a lunge.
Drive up and step straight into the next one.
Keep your shoulders back and grip tight.
exercises.cue: Your grip will quit before your legs; don't let it.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your shoulders forward.

exercises.name: Barbell sumo deadlift
steps: Stand wide with toes out, shins close to the bar.
Grab the bar inside your knees, arms straight.
Push the floor apart with your feet and stand up.
Lower the bar under control.
exercises.cue: Knees out, chest up.
exercises.avoid: Hips shooting up first.

exercises.name: Barbell good morning
steps: Take a light bar on your upper back, as for a back squat.
Soften your knees and push your hips back, lowering your chest.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.
exercises.cue: Light weight, perfect back.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back.

exercises.name: Barbell glute bridge
steps: Sit on the floor, roll a padded bar over your hips and lie back, knees bent.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control.
exercises.cue: Put a towel or pad under the bar.
exercises.avoid: Pushing through your toes.

exercises.name: Pause back squat
steps: Set up a back squat. Set the safety pins or arms just below the bottom of the lift.
Squat down to parallel or below.
Pause for two full seconds at the bottom, staying tight.
Drive up hard.
exercises.cue: Stay braced during the pause; don't relax into the bottom.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing out of the hole.

exercises.name: Barbell Zercher squat
steps: Set the bar low in the rack and cradle it in the crooks of your elbows.
Stand up and step back.
Squat down, chest up, elbows inside your knees.
Drive up and rack it when done.
exercises.cue: Wrap a towel around the bar for your elbows.
exercises.avoid: Letting your upper back round.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead squat
steps: Hold the bar overhead with a wide grip, arms locked.
Squat as deep as you can, bar over your mid-foot.
Stand back up.
Start with an empty bar.
exercises.cue: Push the bar up to the ceiling throughout.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bar drift forward.

exercises.name: Barbell split squat
steps: Take the bar on your back and step into a long split stance.
Lower until your back knee is just off the floor.
Drive back up without moving your feet.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Weight in the front heel.
exercises.avoid: Front knee caving in.

exercises.name: Barbell reverse lunge
steps: Take the bar on your back.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
Drive back up through the front foot.
Alternate legs.
exercises.cue: Step back far enough that your front shin stays vertical.
exercises.avoid: Losing balance; go lighter.

exercises.name: Barbell floor press
steps: Lie on your back in the rack with the bar at arm's length above your chest (set the safety arms just above your chest).
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press it back up.
exercises.cue: No bench needed, and the floor protects your shoulders.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing your elbows off the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell push press
steps: Hold the bar on the front of your shoulders.
Dip your knees slightly, then drive up hard.
Use that drive to press the bar overhead.
Lower it to your shoulders.
exercises.cue: Quick dip, violent drive.
exercises.avoid: Dipping too deep.

exercises.name: Barbell push jerk
steps: Hold the bar on the front of your shoulders.
Dip and drive the bar up.
Drop under it with a second quick dip, catching it with locked arms.
Stand up tall and lower the bar to your shoulders.
exercises.cue: Punch under the bar, don't press it out.
exercises.avoid: Soft elbows at the catch.

exercises.name: Barbell power clean
steps: Set up as for a deadlift, grip just outside your knees.
Lift the bar off the floor, then jump explosively when it passes your knees.
Pull yourself under and catch it on your shoulders, elbows high, in a quarter squat.
Stand up, then lower the bar to your thighs and the floor.
exercises.cue: Bar close to your body the whole way.
exercises.avoid: Reverse-curling the bar up.

exercises.name: Barbell hang power snatch
steps: Hold the bar with a wide grip at mid-thigh.
Jump explosively and pull the bar close to your body.
Punch under it and catch it locked overhead in a quarter squat.
Stand up and lower it under control.
exercises.cue: Start with an empty bar until the catch is solid.
exercises.avoid: Pressing out a soft catch.

exercises.name: Pendlay row
steps: Bend over until your back is almost parallel to the floor, bar on the floor.
Row the bar explosively to your lower chest.
Return it to the floor and reset.
Keep your back flat and still.
exercises.cue: Each rep starts dead from the floor.
exercises.avoid: Standing up as you row.

exercises.name: Snatch-grip deadlift
steps: Take a very wide grip, hands near the collars.
Squat lower than for a normal deadlift, chest up.
Stand up with the bar.
Lower it under control.
exercises.cue: Your upper back will be on fire; stay proud.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back at the start.

exercises.name: Front-rack barbell walking lunge
steps: Hold the bar in the front rack, on your shoulders, elbows high.
Step forward into a lunge.
Drive up and step into the next.
Keep your elbows up the whole way.
exercises.cue: Tall torso; the bar keeps you honest.
exercises.avoid: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward.

exercises.name: Back squat + squat jumps
steps: Do heavy back squats. Set the safety pins or arms just below the bottom of the lift.
Rack the bar.
Within 10 seconds, do max-height bodyweight squat jumps.
Land softly each time.
exercises.cue: Heavy and slow, then light and explosive.
exercises.avoid: Resting between the squats and the jumps.

exercises.name: Clean and jerk
steps: Power clean the bar to your shoulders.
Stand up tall and reset your breath.
Push jerk it overhead.
Lower it to your shoulders, then to the floor.
exercises.cue: Two lifts, two resets. Own each one.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the jerk before you're set.

exercises.name: BOSU dome squat
steps: Stand on the dome side of the BOSU, feet hip-width, either side of the centre.
Find your balance with arms out in front.
Squat down as far as you can control.
