Stand back up without wobbling.
exercises.cue: Slow down, slow up; the wobble is the workout.
exercises.avoid: Knees caving in to find balance.

exercises.name: BOSU step-up
steps: Stand facing the BOSU, dome side up.
Step one foot onto the centre of the dome and stand up on it, the other knee lifting.
Step back down with control.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Stand tall and pause at the top.
exercises.avoid: Pushing off the back foot.

exercises.name: BOSU forward lunge
steps: Stand a long step behind the BOSU, dome side up.
Lunge forward, landing your front foot in the centre of the dome.
Sink until your back knee is just off the floor.
Push back to standing. Alternate legs.
exercises.cue: Land softly and stick the landing before you lower.
exercises.avoid: Front knee wobbling side to side.

exercises.name: BOSU glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your feet on the dome, knees bent.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.
exercises.cue: Keep the BOSU still under your feet.
exercises.avoid: Pushing through your toes.

exercises.name: BOSU forearm plank
steps: Put your forearms on the dome and your feet on the floor behind you.
Lift into a straight plank.
Keep the dome from rocking.
Hold.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes; the wobble goes straight to your abs.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging.

exercises.name: BOSU crunch
steps: Sit on the dome so your lower back rests on it, feet flat on the floor.
Lean back over the dome, hands by your ears.
Crunch up, curling your ribs toward your hips.
Lower slowly back over the dome.
exercises.cue: The dome lets you start from a stretch; use the full range.
exercises.avoid: Pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: BOSU single-leg reach
steps: Stand on one leg on the centre of the dome.
Reach the free foot forward, to the side and behind you, tapping the floor lightly.
Bend the standing knee to reach further.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Standing knee tracks over the middle of the foot.
exercises.avoid: Putting weight on the tapping foot.

exercises.name: BOSU side plank
steps: Lie on your side with your forearm on the dome, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold without letting the dome rock.
Switch sides halfway through.
exercises.cue: Push the dome away with your forearm.
exercises.avoid: Hips drooping.

exercises.name: BOSU Russian twist
steps: Sit on the dome, lean back and lift your feet off the floor.
Balance there, hands together in front of your chest.
Rotate your chest to one side, then the other.
Hold a weight to make it harder.
exercises.cue: Balance first, then twist.
exercises.avoid: Slumping into the dome.

exercises.name: BOSU dead bug
steps: Lie with your lower back on the dome, arms up, knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Keep the dome still under your back.
Return and switch sides.
exercises.cue: Slow and controlled; rocking means you're rushing.
exercises.avoid: Arching off the dome.

exercises.name: BOSU V-up
steps: Sit on the dome and lean back until your shoulders are just off the floor, arms overhead.
Fold up, reaching your hands to your feet as your legs come up.
Lower back to the start without touching down.
Keep the reps smooth.
exercises.cue: Balance on the dome at the top of each rep.
exercises.avoid: Swinging your arms to get up.

exercises.name: BOSU dome push-up
steps: Put your hands on the dome, feet on the floor behind you.
Lower your chest to the dome.
Press back up.
Drop to your knees to make it easier.
exercises.cue: Hands close together; the dome wobbles, so stay tight.
exercises.avoid: Elbows flaring out wide.

exercises.name: BOSU push-up hop-over
steps: Set up a push-up with both hands on the flat BOSU platform (dome down).
Walk or hop one hand off to the floor, then the other, and do a push-up on the floor.
Hop back onto the BOSU and off the other side.
Keep going side to side.
exercises.cue: Quick hands, still hips.
exercises.avoid: Hips swinging with each hop.

exercises.name: Single-leg dumbbell row on BOSU
steps: Stand on one leg on the dome, a dumbbell or kettlebell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward, the free leg reaching back.
Row the weight to your hip.
Finish all reps, then switch legs and hands.
exercises.cue: Balance first, then row.
exercises.avoid: Twisting your hips open as you row.

exercises.name: BOSU jump and stick
steps: Stand a small step behind the BOSU, dome side up.
Jump forward onto the dome, landing with both feet.
Stick the landing for two seconds.
Step off backward and go again.
exercises.cue: Land softly in a half squat.
exercises.avoid: Landing with straight legs.

exercises.name: BOSU skaters
steps: Stand beside the BOSU on one leg.
Leap sideways and land on the dome with the outside foot.
Stick the landing, then leap back off to the floor.
Keep going side to side.
exercises.cue: Sink into the landing.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving in on the dome.

exercises.name: BOSU tuck jumps
steps: Stand on the dome, feet hip-width.
Jump up and pull your knees to your chest.
Land back on the dome softly.
Stabilise before the next jump.
exercises.cue: Stick every landing before jumping again.
exercises.avoid: Chaining the jumps before you're stable.

exercises.name: BOSU 180° jump turns
steps: Stand on the dome.
Jump and turn half a circle in the air.
Land on the dome facing the other way.
Alternate turning directions.
exercises.cue: Spot a point and find it again.
exercises.avoid: Landing off-centre.

exercises.name: BOSU lunge + twist
steps: Lunge forward with your front foot on the dome.
At the bottom, rotate your chest toward the front leg, hands together.
Rotate back and push back to standing.
Alternate legs.
exercises.cue: The front knee stays still while your chest turns.
exercises.avoid: The dome tipping under the front foot.

exercises.name: BOSU mountain climbers + push-up
steps: Flip the BOSU dome down and grip its edges in a high plank.
Do 8 mountain climbers.
Do 1 push-up.
That's one round. Keep going.
exercises.cue: Keep the platform level the whole time.
exercises.avoid: Hips bouncing during the climbers.

exercises.name: BOSU squat + press
steps: Stand on the flat side of the BOSU (dome down), holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Squat down.
Stand up and press the weights overhead.
Lower them back to your shoulders.
exercises.cue: Keep the platform level.
exercises.avoid: Rushing; balance first, then power.

exercises.name: Stability ball wall squat
steps: Put the ball between your lower back and a wall, feet a step forward.
Squat down, letting the ball roll up your back.
Go until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Stand back up.
exercises.cue: The ball lets you sit straight down; use the full depth.
exercises.avoid: Feet too close to the wall.

exercises.name: Stability ball hip thrust
steps: Sit on the ball, then walk your feet out until your shoulders rest on it.
Let your hips drop toward the floor.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips level with your knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
exercises.cue: Keep your chin tucked and the ball still.
exercises.avoid: Rolling off the ball; walk out slowly.

exercises.name: Single-leg stability ball hamstring curl
steps: Lie on your back with one heel on the ball, the other leg raised.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Roll the ball toward you with the working heel.
Roll it back out. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Hips stay level and high.
exercises.avoid: Rotating toward the working leg.

exercises.name: Stability ball back extension
steps: Lie face down over the ball, hips on top, toes on the floor (feet against a wall helps).
Hands by your ears.
Lift your chest until your body is straight.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes to lift, not just your back.
exercises.avoid: Hyperextending past straight.

exercises.name: Stability ball Y-T-W raises
steps: Lie face down on the ball with your chest off the front, toes on the floor.
Raise your arms into a Y, thumbs up, and lower.
Raise them straight out to the sides in a T, and lower.
Pull your elbows back into a W. Do all reps of each shape.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your shoulder blades together on every raise.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging up to your ears.

exercises.name: Stability ball dead bug
steps: Lie on your back holding the ball between your hands and knees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Keep one hand and the opposite knee pressing on the ball, and straighten the other arm and leg.
Bring them back and switch sides.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the ball hard with the hand and knee that stay.
exercises.avoid: Lower back lifting.

exercises.name: Stability ball plank
steps: Put your forearms on the ball, feet on the floor behind you.
Lift into a straight plank.
Keep the ball from rolling.
Hold.
exercises.cue: Pull your elbows toward your toes without moving them.
exercises.avoid: Hips piking up.

exercises.name: Stability ball crunch
steps: Sit on the ball and walk your feet out until your lower back rests on it.
Lean back over the ball, hands by your ears.
Crunch up, curling your ribs toward your hips.
Lower back over the ball.
exercises.cue: Use the stretch at the bottom.
exercises.avoid: Pulling your head with your hands.

exercises.name: Stability ball walkout
steps: Lie face down over the ball, hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward until only your shins, then your feet, are on the ball.
Hold for a breath in a straight plank.
Walk your hands back to the start.
exercises.cue: Hips stay level as you walk out.
exercises.avoid: Sagging when you're furthest out.

exercises.name: Stability ball pass
steps: Lie on your back holding the ball overhead.
Crunch up and pass the ball from your hands to between your feet.
Lower down with the ball between your feet.
Crunch up and take it back. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the ball with your ankles.
exercises.avoid: Lower back arching when the legs lower.

exercises.name: Stability ball Russian twist bridge
steps: Rest your shoulders on the ball, hips up in a bridge, arms straight up with palms together.
Roll across the ball onto one shoulder as you rotate your arms to that side.
Roll back through the middle to the other shoulder.
Keep your hips high the whole time.
exercises.cue: Move your whole torso as one piece.
exercises.avoid: Hips dropping as you roll.

exercises.name: Feet-on-ball push-up
steps: Put your shins or feet on the ball and your hands on the floor.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press back up.
The further out your feet, the harder it gets.
exercises.cue: Keep the ball dead still.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell press on a stability ball
steps: Sit on the ball with dumbbells, walk out until your upper back rests on it, hips up.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower them slowly.
Keep your hips up in a bridge throughout.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes to keep the bridge.
exercises.avoid: Letting your hips drop.

exercises.name: Stability ball side plank
steps: Lie on your side with your feet stacked on the ball, forearm on the floor.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Keep the ball from rolling.
Switch sides halfway through.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the ball with your feet.
exercises.avoid: Rolling forward.

exercises.name: Kneeling ball balance
steps: Put your hands and knees on the ball, near a wall or with space around you.
Slowly lift your hands off until you're kneeling upright.
Balance with your arms out.
Come down with hands first.
exercises.cue: Tiny adjustments; stiff arms make it worse.
exercises.avoid: Trying it near anything hard or sharp.

exercises.name: Stability ball jackknife + push-up
steps: Set up a push-up with your shins on the ball.
Do a push-up.
Pull your knees to your chest, rolling the ball in.
Roll it back out. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Keep your shoulders over your hands.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging between moves.

exercises.name: Stability ball pike push-up
steps: Set up a plank with your feet on the ball.
Pike your hips up high, rolling the ball in on your toes.
In the pike, lower your head toward the floor and press back up.
Roll back out to the plank.
exercises.cue: Stack your hips over your shoulders in the pike.
exercises.avoid: Letting the ball roll sideways.

exercises.name: Partner stability ball pass
steps: Lie on your backs head to head, arms overhead.
One partner crunches up holding the ball and passes it overhead to the other.
The other catches it and lowers it to the floor overhead.
They crunch up and pass it back.
exercises.cue: Hand the ball over at the top of the crunch.
exercises.avoid: Throwing it; it's a handover.

exercises.name: TRX face pull
steps: Face the anchor holding the handles, arms straight, leaning back.
Pull the handles toward your face, elbows high and wide.
Finish with your hands beside your ears.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Squeeze between your shoulder blades at the top.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging up to your ears.

exercises.name: TRX Y-T-W
steps: Lean back holding the handles, arms straight in front.
Pull yourself up by raising your straight arms into a Y. Lower.
Pull up with arms straight out to the sides in a T. Lower.
Pull up with elbows bent and pulled back into a W. Do all reps of each shape.
exercises.cue: Walk your feet forward to make it harder.
exercises.avoid: Bending your elbows on the Y and T.

exercises.name: TRX biceps curl
steps: Face the anchor, palms up, arms straight, leaning back.
Keeping your elbows still and high, curl your hands toward your forehead.
Your body rises as you curl.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Elbows stay pointing at the anchor.
exercises.avoid: Dropping your elbows to row instead.

exercises.name: TRX archer row
steps: Lean back holding both handles.
Row with one arm while the other arm straightens out to the side.
Lower and repeat to the other side.
Keep your body straight.
exercises.cue: The straight arm only helps; the bent arm does the work.
exercises.avoid: Twisting your hips.

exercises.name: TRX chest press
steps: Face away from the anchor, handles at your chest, arms bent.
Lean forward until you're supported by the straps.
Press your arms straight, pushing your body back up.
Lower slowly. Step your feet back to make it harder.
exercises.cue: Plank body the whole time.
exercises.avoid: Letting the straps rub your arms; press slightly wider.

exercises.name: TRX chest fly
steps: Face away from the anchor, arms straight in front at chest height.
Lean forward and open your arms wide, lowering your chest between them.
Squeeze your arms back together to rise up.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
exercises.cue: Start upright; lean further only when it's easy.
exercises.avoid: Going so deep your shoulders complain.

exercises.name: TRX triceps extension
steps: Face away from the anchor, arms straight overhead holding the handles.
Lean forward and bend only your elbows, bringing your hands toward your forehead.
Straighten your arms to push back up.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
exercises.cue: Upper arms stay still.
exercises.avoid: Letting the elbows flare out.

exercises.name: TRX single-arm chest press
steps: Face away from the anchor holding one handle with one hand, the other arm out to the side.
Lean forward and lower your chest toward the handle.
Press back up without letting your body rotate.
Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes and abs to stop the twist.
exercises.avoid: Rotating toward the working arm.

exercises.name: TRX-assisted pistol squat
steps: Face the anchor holding both handles, standing on one leg, the other straight out in front.
Squat down on the standing leg, using the straps only for balance.
Stand back up, pulling as little as possible.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Use less and less help each week.
exercises.avoid: Pulling yourself up with your arms.

exercises.name: TRX skater squat
steps: Face the anchor holding the handles, standing on one leg.
Squat on that leg, reaching the other leg back and across behind you.
Stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Hips back, chest up.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving inward.

exercises.name: TRX reverse lunge + row
steps: Face the anchor holding the handles, arms straight.
Step back into a reverse lunge, arms staying straight.
Drive up to standing and row the handles to your ribs.
Straighten your arms and lunge with the other leg.
exercises.cue: The lunge and the row flow together.
exercises.avoid: Pulling yourself out of the lunge.

exercises.name: TRX sprinter start
steps: Face away from the anchor with the handles under your armpits, leaning forward.
Stagger your feet as if at a starting line.
Drive the back knee up explosively, rising onto the toes of the front foot.
Return to the start. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Lean hard into the straps; it's a sprint start in place.
exercises.avoid: Standing upright.

exercises.name: TRX sprinter start + hop
steps: Set up the sprinter start.
Drive the back knee up and hop off the front foot.
Land softly on the same foot and sink back into the start.
Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Quiet landings.
exercises.avoid: Landing on a stiff leg.

exercises.name: TRX mountain climbers
steps: Put your feet in the foot cradles and set up a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips level.
Count each knee.
exercises.cue: The straps swing if your hips bounce.
exercises.avoid: Hips piking up.

exercises.name: TRX oblique knee tuck
steps: Put your feet in the foot cradles and set up a high plank.
Pull both knees in toward one elbow, rotating your hips.
Extend back to the plank.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Rotate from your waist, not your shoulders.
exercises.avoid: Shoulders drifting away from over your hands.

exercises.name: TRX suspended plank
steps: Put your feet in the foot cradles.
Set up a forearm plank with your feet hanging in the straps.
Keep the straps still.
Hold.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your legs together.
exercises.avoid: Letting your hips drop.

exercises.name: TRX hip press
steps: Lie on your back with your heels in the foot cradles, legs straight.
Drive your heels down into the straps and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Push the straps down, not forward.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back.

exercises.name: TRX single-leg burpee
steps: Face away from the anchor with one foot in a foot cradle behind you.
Squat down, put your hands on the floor, and kick the strap leg back into a plank.
Do a push-up, bring the foot back and jump up on the standing leg.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Stay balanced; it's a burpee on one leg.
exercises.avoid: Rushing and swinging the strap.

exercises.name: TRX spiderman push-up
steps: Put your feet in the foot cradles and set up a push-up.
As you lower, bring one knee out to the side toward your elbow.
Press up and return the leg.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Hips stay level while the knee moves.
exercises.avoid: Sagging when the leg comes out.

exercises.name: Ring pull-up
steps: Hang from the rings, palms facing each other.
Pull up until the rings reach your chest, turning your palms toward you.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
Keep your legs still.
exercises.cue: Let the rings turn freely; they're kinder to your shoulders than a bar.
exercises.avoid: Kicking to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Ring dead hang
steps: Grab the rings and hang with straight arms.
Shoulders slightly engaged.
Keep your legs still.
Drop off before your grip fails completely.
exercises.cue: The rings move, so your grip works harder than on a bar.
exercises.avoid: Swinging.

exercises.name: Ring false-grip hang
steps: Put the rings deep in your palms, wrists bent over them.
Hang with your arms bent to 90 degrees or straight, wrists staying over the rings.
Hold.
This is the grip used for muscle-ups.
exercises.cue: Chalk helps.
exercises.avoid: Letting the wrist slip back under the ring.

exercises.name: Ring L-sit
steps: Support yourself on the rings with straight arms, rings turned out slightly.
Lift your straight legs until they're level with the floor.
Hold the L shape.
Tuck your knees to make it easier.
exercises.cue: Push the rings down hard and keep your shoulders low.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging up to your ears.

exercises.name: Ring push-up, turned out
steps: Set the rings a few inches off the floor and set up a push-up on them.
Lower your chest between the rings.
Press up and turn the rings out at the top, palms facing forward.
Hold the turn-out for a breath.
exercises.cue: The turn-out at the top is where the strength is built.
exercises.avoid: Rings drifting wide.

exercises.name: Ring fly
steps: Set the rings low and set up a push-up on them, knees down to start.
Open your arms wide, lowering your chest between the rings.
Squeeze the rings back together to rise.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
exercises.cue: Only go as wide as you can pull back.
exercises.avoid: Dropping into a deep stretch you can't control.

exercises.name: Ring dip negatives
steps: Jump up into a ring support, arms locked.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can, about five seconds.
Put your feet down at the bottom.
Jump back up and repeat.
exercises.cue: Keep the rings close to your body.
exercises.avoid: Dropping the last part.

exercises.name: Ring hanging knee raise
steps: Hang from the rings with straight arms.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
exercises.cue: Curl your hips up at the top.
exercises.avoid: Swinging your legs.

exercises.name: Toes to rings
steps: Hang from the rings with straight arms.
Lift your straight legs until your toes touch the rings.
Lower slowly.
Pull the rings down to help.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your legs together.
exercises.avoid: Kipping.

exercises.name: Skin the cat
steps: Hang from the rings.
Tuck your knees and roll backward, bringing your legs up and over until you're hanging upside down behind the rings.
Lower as far as your shoulders comfortably allow.
Pull back through the same way.
exercises.cue: Slow and controlled; stop where your shoulders say stop.
exercises.avoid: Dropping into the bottom position.

exercises.name: Ring tuck front lever
steps: Hang from the rings.
Pull your straight arms down toward your hips and tuck your knees to your chest.
Lift your hips until your back is level with the floor.
Hold.
exercises.cue: Arms stay straight; pull with your lats.
exercises.avoid: Bending your arms.

exercises.name: Ring front lever raise
steps: Hang from the rings with straight arms.
Keeping your body straight (or in a tuck), pull your hips up until your body is level with the floor.
Lower back to the hang under control.
Keep your arms straight throughout.
exercises.cue: The slower you lower, the stronger you get.
exercises.avoid: Piking at the hips.

exercises.name: Ring archer push-up
steps: Set the rings low and set up a push-up on them.
Lower toward one hand while sliding the other ring out to the side, arm straight.
Press back up to the middle.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: The straight arm slides; the bent arm works.
exercises.avoid: Losing control of the sliding ring.

exercises.name: Ring dip + L-sit
steps: Support yourself on the rings.
Do a dip.
At the top, lift your legs into an L-sit and hold for 3 seconds.
Lower your legs and do the next dip.
exercises.cue: Rings close to your body at the top.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging in the L-sit.

exercises.name: Ring push-up + fallout
steps: Set the straps or rings low and set up a push-up on them.
Do a push-up.
From the top, slide your arms forward overhead into a fallout.
Pull back and go into the next push-up.
exercises.cue: Keep your hips tucked on the fallout.
exercises.avoid: Lower back sagging.

exercises.name: TRX mountain climbers + pike
steps: Put your feet in the foot cradles and set up a high plank.
Do 6 mountain climbers.
Then pike your hips up to the ceiling once.
That's one round. Keep going.
exercises.cue: Shoulders stay over your hands.
exercises.avoid: Swinging straps.

exercises.name: Ring row + pull-up ladder
steps: Do 1 ring row, then 1 pull-up.
Then 2 rows and 2 pull-ups.
Keep adding one of each.
Stop at the top number.
exercises.cue: Adjust the rings once to pull-up height and row by walking your feet under them.
exercises.avoid: Sloppy half reps as you tire.

exercises.name: Parallette support shrugs
steps: Support yourself on the parallettes with straight arms, feet on the floor or lifted.
Let your shoulders sink up toward your ears.
Push down hard to lift your body back up, arms staying straight.
Repeat slowly.
exercises.cue: Only your shoulder blades move.
exercises.avoid: Bending your elbows.

exercises.name: Parallette tuck sit
steps: Grip the parallettes, arms straight, and lift your body off the floor.
Pull your knees up to your chest.
Hold, shoulders pushed down.
The easier step before the L-sit.
exercises.cue: Push the parallettes into the floor.
exercises.avoid: Shrugging up.

exercises.name: Parallette V-sit
steps: From an L-sit on the parallettes, lean back slightly.
Lift your straight legs higher, toward your face.
Hold the V shape.
Build up from the L-sit first.
exercises.cue: Hips forward, shoulders pushed down hard.
exercises.avoid: Bending the knees.

exercises.name: Parallette support knee raise
steps: Support yourself on the parallettes with straight arms, feet lifted.
Pull your knees to your chest.
Lower them slowly without touching down.
Keep your arms locked.
exercises.cue: Round your lower back slightly at the top.
exercises.avoid: Swinging the legs.

exercises.name: Parallette archer push-up
steps: Set the parallettes wide and set up a push-up on them.
Lower toward one hand while the other arm straightens.
Press back up.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: The deep range on the parallettes makes this brutal.
exercises.avoid: Hips twisting.

exercises.name: Floor-to-parallette plyo push-up
steps: Set up a push-up with your hands on the floor between the parallettes.
Lower and explode up, landing your hands on the parallettes.
Do a push-up on the parallettes.
Hop your hands back to the floor and go again.
exercises.cue: Explode; catch with soft elbows.
exercises.avoid: Missing the grip; start with the parallettes close.

exercises.name: Parallette planche lean
steps: Set up a push-up on the parallettes.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands, arms straight.
Round your upper back slightly.
Hold the lean.
exercises.cue: Lean further to make it harder.
exercises.avoid: Bending your elbows.

exercises.name: Parallette handstand hold (wall)
steps: Put the parallettes a hand-length from a wall.
Grip them and kick up so your heels rest on the wall.
Push tall through your shoulders.
Come down one leg at a time.
exercises.cue: Ribs in, glutes tight.
exercises.avoid: A banana-shaped back.

exercises.name: Parallette lateral hops
steps: Stand beside one parallette.
Hop sideways over it with both feet.
Hop straight back.
Keep it quick and light.
exercises.cue: Tiny, quick hops over the bar.
exercises.avoid: Clipping the parallette; go slower first.

exercises.name: Parallette dip + knee raise
steps: Support yourself on the parallettes.
Do a dip.
At the top, pull your knees to your chest.
Lower them and do the next dip.
exercises.cue: Lock your arms before the knee raise.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the dip.

exercises.name: Jumping pull-up
steps: Stand under the bar on a box or the floor, hands on the bar.
Jump and pull at the same time until your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can.
Reset and repeat.
exercises.cue: The slow lowering does the building.
exercises.avoid: Dropping straight down.

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-up
steps: Loop a band over the bar and put one knee or foot in it.
Pull up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower all the way down.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.
exercises.cue: Pull your elbows into your back pockets.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing out of the bottom on the band.

exercises.name: Wide-grip pull-up
steps: Grip the bar well outside shoulder-width.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower all the way.
Legs still.
exercises.cue: Think of pulling the bar apart.
exercises.avoid: Half reps.

exercises.name: Commando pull-up
steps: Stand side-on under the bar and grip it with hands close together, one in front of the other.
Pull up so your head passes one side of the bar.
Lower, then pull up so your head passes the other side.
Keep alternating.
exercises.cue: Keep your body from spinning.
exercises.avoid: Kicking.

exercises.name: 1.5-rep pull-up
steps: Pull all the way up.
Lower halfway.
Pull back up to the top.
Lower all the way. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: The extra half rep doubles the time under tension.
exercises.avoid: Shortening the bottom.

exercises.name: Archer pull-up
steps: Take a very wide grip.
Pull toward one hand while the other arm straightens along the bar.
Lower and repeat toward the other side.
Keep the straight arm straight.
exercises.cue: A stepping stone toward one-arm pull-ups.
exercises.avoid: Bending both arms equally.

exercises.name: Typewriter pull-up
steps: Pull up with a wide grip.
At the top, slide your chest across to one hand.
Slide across to the other hand, staying at the top.
Lower down. That's one rep.
exercises.cue: Stay high the whole traverse.
exercises.avoid: Dropping down between sides.

exercises.name: L-sit pull-up
steps: Hang from the bar and lift your straight legs to level.
Hold the L and pull up.
Lower without dropping your legs.
Tuck your knees to make it easier.
exercises.cue: Abs and lats at the same time.
exercises.avoid: Legs sinking as you pull.

exercises.name: Hanging straight-leg raise
steps: Hang from the bar.
Lift your straight legs until they're level with the floor or higher.
Lower slowly.
No swinging.
exercises.cue: Pull the bar down toward your hips.
exercises.avoid: Kipping.

exercises.name: Hanging oblique knee raise
steps: Hang from the bar.
Raise your knees toward one shoulder.
Lower and raise them toward the other shoulder.
Keep your upper body still.
exercises.cue: Curl your hips sideways, not just up.
exercises.avoid: Swinging from side to side.

exercises.name: Hanging bicycle
steps: Hang from the bar.
Pedal your legs as if riding a bike, knees high.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Upper body still.
exercises.cue: Big knee drives.
exercises.avoid: Letting the body swing.

exercises.name: Hanging L-sit hold
steps: Hang from the bar.
Lift your straight legs to level with the floor.
Hold.
Tuck to make it easier.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your quads to keep your legs straight.
exercises.avoid: Legs slowly sinking.

exercises.name: Rope climb negatives
steps: Climb a short way up using your legs.
Lock your feet around the rope.
Lower hand over hand as slowly as you can.
Release your feet near the bottom.
exercises.cue: Slow hands on the way down.
exercises.avoid: Sliding; you'll burn your hands.

exercises.name: Rope L-hang
steps: Grab the rope high with both hands and hang.
Lift your legs straight out in front to level.
Hold.
Tuck your knees to make it easier.
exercises.cue: Squeeze the rope and your abs.
exercises.avoid: Swinging.

exercises.name: Rope hanging knee raise
steps: Hang from the rope with both hands.
Pull your knees to your chest.
Lower slowly.
Keep your grip tight.
exercises.cue: The rope swings more than a bar; stay controlled.
exercises.avoid: Using momentum.

exercises.name: Lateral sled drag
steps: Attach straps to the sled and hold them at your hips, standing side-on.
Step sideways away from the sled, staying low.
Drag it the whole length.
Come back leading with the other side.
exercises.cue: Stay in a half squat.
exercises.avoid: Crossing your feet.

exercises.name: Sled rope pull
steps: Tie a rope to the sled and stand at the far end of it.
Pull the sled toward you hand over hand in an athletic stance.
Walk it back out.
Repeat.
exercises.cue: Use your legs and hips as well as your arms.
exercises.avoid: Standing tall and pulling with only your arms.

exercises.name: Sled chest press walk
steps: Face away from the sled holding the straps at your chest.
Press your arms forward as you step forward.
Bring your hands back to your chest and step again.
Keep pressing for the whole length.
exercises.cue: Lean into each press.
exercises.avoid: Walking without pressing.

exercises.name: Low sled push
steps: Grip the sled's low handles, arms straight, body almost parallel to the floor.
Drive the sled with short, powerful steps.
Stay low for the whole length.
Walk back.
exercises.cue: It's a sprint on all fours.
exercises.avoid: Rising up halfway.

exercises.name: Glute-ham raise negatives
steps: Set up on the GHD with your knees behind the pad and feet locked.
Start upright.
Lower forward as slowly as you can, straight from knees to head.
Push back up with your hands.
exercises.cue: Fight every centimetre on the way down.
exercises.avoid: Bending at the hips.

exercises.name: GHD rotational back extension
steps: Set up for a back extension on the GHD.
Lower down.
Rise up while rotating your chest to one side.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Rotate at the top, not the bottom.
exercises.avoid: Hyperextending.

exercises.name: GHD sit-up with twist
steps: Set up for GHD sit-ups.
Lean back to parallel.
Sit up and rotate to touch one foot plate.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Control the lowering.
exercises.avoid: Going too deep too soon; build up slowly.

exercises.name: GHD back extension hold
steps: Set up for a back extension.
Rise until your body is straight.
Hold there.
Hands by your ears or holding a plate to make it harder.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes.
exercises.avoid: Arching past straight.

exercises.name: Landmine Romanian deadlift
steps: Stand facing the free end of the bar, holding it with both hands.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.
exercises.cue: Flat back, hips back.
exercises.avoid: Rounding to reach lower.

exercises.name: Landmine lateral lunge
steps: Hold the end of the bar at your chest with both hands.
Step wide to one side and sit into that hip.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Bar stays at your chest.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving in.

exercises.name: Landmine split jerk
steps: Hold the bar end at your shoulder.
Dip and drive up explosively.
Split your feet into a lunge as you punch the bar up and forward.
Step your feet back together. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Punch and split at the same moment.
exercises.avoid: Pressing the bar instead of driving it.

exercises.name: Landmine clean + press
steps: Stand beside the bar end, hinge and grab it with one hand.
Explode up and pull it to your shoulder.
Press it up and forward.
Lower it back down. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Hips power the clean.
exercises.avoid: Curling the bar up.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling sledgehammer strikes
steps: Kneel on one knee beside the tire.
Swing the hammer over your shoulder and strike the tire.
Let it bounce, then swing again.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: All trunk, no legs.
exercises.avoid: Striking with bent, weak arms.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer strikes + burpees
steps: Strike the tire.
Put the hammer down and do the burpees.
Pick it up and strike again.
Rest only when all rounds are done.
exercises.cue: Every strike at full effort.
exercises.avoid: Dropping the hammer; lay it down.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer strikes + sprint
steps: Strike the tire.
Lay the hammer down and sprint 15 m.
Walk back.
Repeat.
exercises.cue: Violent strikes, fast feet.
exercises.avoid: Leaving the hammer somewhere you'll trip on it.

exercises.name: Tire decline push-up
steps: Put your feet on the tire and your hands on the floor.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press back up.
Hands on the tire instead to make it easier.
exercises.cue: Straight body.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging.

exercises.name: Tire dips
steps: Sit on the edge of the tire and put your hands beside your hips.
Slide off so you're supported by your arms.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Press back up.
exercises.cue: Elbows point back.
exercises.avoid: Shoulders rolling forward.

exercises.name: Tire push
steps: Stand the tire on its tread or lay it flat.
Put your hands on it and drive it across the floor with short, powerful steps.
Stay low.
Push it back.
exercises.cue: Sprint mechanics, heavy load.
exercises.avoid: Standing up tall.

exercises.name: Tire deadlift hold
steps: Squat down at one side of a tire lying flat and grab the edge.
Stand up so that side lifts off the floor.
Hold at the top.
Lower it slowly.
exercises.cue: Flat back and a big breath before you lift.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to lift.

exercises.name: Lateral bench jumps
steps: Stand beside a bench, feet together.
Jump sideways over it with both feet.
Land and jump straight back.
Keep a steady rhythm.
exercises.cue: Pull your knees up to clear it.
exercises.avoid: Clipping the bench; start with a low one.

exercises.name: Bench reverse crunch
steps: Lie on the bench, holding its end behind your head.
Pull your knees to your chest and lift your hips off the bench.
Lower slowly.
Keep the movement controlled.
exercises.cue: Curl your hips up, don't swing them.
exercises.avoid: Using momentum.

exercises.name: Burpee + bench jump-over
steps: Do a burpee beside the bench.
Jump sideways over it.
Burpee on the other side.
Jump back.
exercises.cue: Soft landings.
exercises.avoid: Catching your feet on the bench.

exercises.name: Banded squat
steps: Stand on the band, feet shoulder-width, and loop the top over your shoulders or hold it at your shoulders.
Squat down.
Stand up against the band.
The band makes the top of the rep the hardest.
exercises.cue: Drive hard through the top.
exercises.avoid: Knees caving in.

exercises.name: Banded deadlift
steps: Stand on the band, feet hip-width, holding the ends with arms straight.
Hinge down with a flat back.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes at the top.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back.

exercises.name: Mini-band lateral walk
steps: Loop a mini band around your legs just above your knees or around your ankles.
Sink into a quarter squat.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Go one way, then back.
exercises.cue: Toes forward, knees out.
exercises.avoid: Letting your feet come together.

exercises.name: Band triceps pushdown
steps: Anchor the band high.
Hold the ends with your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.
exercises.cue: Elbows stay pinned.
exercises.avoid: Leaning over to push with your body.

exercises.name: Band curl
steps: Stand on the band, holding the ends, palms forward.
Curl your hands to your shoulders.
Lower slowly.
Elbows stay at your sides.
exercises.cue: Squeeze at the top.
exercises.avoid: Swinging your body.

exercises.name: Forward sled drag
steps: Attach straps to the sled and hold them at your hips, or over your shoulders with a harness, facing away from it.
Lean forward and walk with long, driving steps.
Drag it the whole length.
Walk back and go again.
exercises.cue: Push the floor back behind you with every step.
exercises.avoid: Short, choppy steps.

exercises.name: Heavy sled march
steps: Load the sled heavy.
Hands on the high handles, arms straight, body at 45 degrees.
March it forward with slow, powerful steps, driving each knee.
Keep moving; don't stop mid-length.
exercises.cue: Slow and grinding: this is strength, not speed.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back.

exercises.name: Light sled sprints
steps: Load the sled light.
Grip the high handles and sprint it the full length.
Walk it back.
Rest fully between lengths.
exercises.cue: Sprint mechanics: arms locked, knees driving, fast feet.
exercises.avoid: Loading it so heavy you can't sprint.

exercises.name: Sled push out, drag back
steps: Push the sled the full length.
Grab the straps and drag it back walking backward.
No rest at the turn.
That's one round.
exercises.cue: Stay low for both halves.
exercises.avoid: Standing up tall on the drag.

exercises.name: Sled pull-through
steps: Face away from the sled with a strap running between your legs, both hands on it.
Hinge forward, letting the strap pull your hands back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to stand up tall, dragging the sled a step.
Walk a step back into the hinge and repeat along the length.
exercises.cue: It's a kettlebell swing that moves a sled.
exercises.avoid: Squatting instead of hinging.

exercises.name: Backward sled lunge drag
steps: Face the sled holding the straps, arms straight.
Step back into a deep reverse lunge, dragging the sled.
Drive up and lunge back with the other leg.
Keep going for the whole length.
exercises.cue: Quads on fire; that's the point.
exercises.avoid: Short, shallow lunges.

exercises.name: Seated sled rope pull
steps: Tie a rope to the sled and sit on the floor at the far end, legs straight.
Pull the sled to you hand over hand without using your legs.
Walk it back out.
Repeat.
exercises.cue: Sit tall and pull with your back.
exercises.avoid: Leaning way back to use your bodyweight.

exercises.name: Sled bear crawl drag
steps: Attach a strap from the sled to a belt or harness around your waist.
Get into a bear position, knees an inch off the floor.
Crawl forward, dragging the sled.
Crawl the whole length.
exercises.cue: Low hips, flat back.
exercises.avoid: Loading it so heavy your hips rise.

exercises.name: Sled drag + farmer carry
steps: Drag the sled the length, walking forward.
Pick up heavy dumbbells or kettlebells at the far end.
Carry them back to the start.
Go straight into the next drag.
exercises.cue: Your grip will be shot; stand tall anyway.
exercises.avoid: Dropping the weights; set them down.

exercises.name: Heavy sled push + broad jumps
steps: Push a heavy sled one length.
Straight away, do broad jumps back toward the start.
Stick each landing.
Walk back to the sled.
exercises.cue: Heavy and grinding, then light and explosive.
exercises.avoid: Resting between the push and the jumps.

exercises.name: Partner sled relay
steps: One partner pushes the sled a length while the other holds a wall sit.
At the end, swap: the pusher wall sits, the other pushes back.
Keep swapping without rest.
Count lengths as a team.
exercises.cue: The faster you push, the shorter your partner's wall sit.
exercises.avoid: Easing off on your push.

exercises.name: Overhead sledgehammer strikes
steps: Stand square to the tire, feet hip-width.
Lift the hammer straight up overhead, hands sliding apart.
Strike straight down onto the tire, sliding your top hand down to meet the other.
Let it bounce and lift again.
exercises.cue: Bend your knees as you strike.
exercises.avoid: Straight legs and a rounded back.

exercises.name: Switch-hand sledgehammer strikes
steps: Strike the tire from over your right shoulder.
On the rebound, switch your hand positions.
Strike from over your left shoulder.
Keep alternating every strike.
exercises.cue: Switch smoothly on the bounce.
exercises.avoid: Only swinging from your stronger side.

exercises.name: One-arm sledgehammer strikes
steps: Grip the hammer near the middle of the handle with one hand.
Swing it over your shoulder and strike the tire.
Control the rebound.
Finish all reps, then switch hands.
exercises.cue: Choke up the handle for more control.
exercises.avoid: Letting the rebound yank your shoulder.

exercises.name: Squat + sledgehammer strike
steps: Hold the hammer across your body at chest height.
Squat down.
Drive up out of the squat, lifting the hammer overhead.
Strike the tire as you sink into the next squat.
exercises.cue: Legs drive the lift; the strike rides the squat.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge + sledgehammer strike
steps: Stand close to the tire with the hammer.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
Drive up and strike the tire as you stand.
Alternate legs and striking sides.
exercises.cue: Stand, then strike: the power comes from the legs.
exercises.avoid: Striking from the lunge position.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer intervals
steps: Strike the tire as fast and hard as you can for 20 seconds.
Rest for 10 seconds.
Switch sides each round.
That's one round.
exercises.cue: Every round as hard as the first.
exercises.avoid: Pacing yourself; it's only 20 seconds.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer halo
steps: Hold the hammer upside down by the handle near the head, head up.
Circle the head of the hammer around your head.
Keep your elbows close and hips still.
Finish all reps, then circle the other way.
exercises.cue: The further down the handle you hold, the harder it gets.
exercises.avoid: Arching your back.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer wrist rotations
steps: Hold the hammer at the end of the handle in one hand, arm at your side, head pointing forward.
Rotate your wrist to tip the head slowly to one side.
Rotate it back up and over to the other side.
Finish all reps, then switch hands.
exercises.cue: Slow and controlled.
exercises.avoid: Swinging your arm.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer overhead carry
steps: Hold the hammer overhead with both hands, arms locked, handle horizontal.
Walk with small steps.
Keep your ribs down.
Lower it before your shoulders give out.
exercises.cue: Arms by your ears.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer front raise
steps: Hold the hammer at the end of the handle with one hand, arm down at your side.
Raise your straight arm to shoulder height in front of you.
Keep the handle level.
Lower slowly. Switch hands halfway.
exercises.cue: Choke up to make it easier.
exercises.avoid: Letting the head drop.

exercises.name: Tire flip + sledgehammer strikes
steps: Flip the tire once.
Pick up the hammer and strike the tire 10 times.
Flip it back.
Strike 10 more times. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Hinge for the flip; don't pull with your back.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the flip when tired.

exercises.name: Tire step-ups
steps: Stand facing a tire lying flat.
Step one foot onto the sidewall and stand up on it.
Step back down with control.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: The soft rubber wobbles a little; stay tall.
exercises.avoid: Pushing off the back foot.

exercises.name: Tire Bulgarian split squat
steps: Stand a long step in front of a tire, the top of your back foot on the sidewall.
Lower until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive back up through the front heel.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Front shin roughly vertical.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing off the back foot.

exercises.name: Tire hip thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the sidewall of a tire lying flat.
Plant your feet, knees bent.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze at the top, then lower.
exercises.cue: Chin tucked, ribs down.
exercises.avoid: Pushing through your toes.

exercises.name: Tire rim walk
steps: Step up onto the sidewall of a tire lying flat.
Walk around the rim, one foot in front of the other.
Arms out for balance.
Step off if you wobble, then step back on.
exercises.cue: Eyes ahead, not down at your feet.
exercises.avoid: Rushing; slow steps are harder and better.

exercises.name: Tire plank walk-around
steps: Put your hands on the sidewall of a tire lying flat and set up a high plank.
Walk your feet sideways around the tire, hands moving along the rim.
Keep your body straight.
Go all the way round, then back the other way.
exercises.cue: Hips level the whole way.
exercises.avoid: Hips piking up.

exercises.name: Tire mountain climbers
steps: Put your hands on the sidewall of a tire lying flat and set up a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low.
Count each knee.
exercises.cue: The raised hands make it easier on your shoulders.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing your hips.

exercises.name: Tire plyo push-up
steps: Put your hands on the sidewall of a tire lying flat and set up a push-up.
Lower your chest toward the tire.
Explode up so your hands leave the rim.
Catch the rim with soft elbows and go again.
exercises.cue: The rubber gives a little bounce; use it.
exercises.avoid: Missing the rim; keep your hands over it.

exercises.name: Tire drag
steps: Tie a rope or strap to the tire.
Face away and drag it the length of your lane, leaning forward.
Or face it and walk backward.
Turn round and drag it back.
exercises.cue: Long, driving steps.
exercises.avoid: Standing upright and pulling with your arms.

exercises.name: Tire rope pull
steps: Tie a rope to the tire and walk to the far end of the rope.
In an athletic stance, pull the tire toward you hand over hand.
Walk it back out.
Repeat.
exercises.cue: Use your hips and legs as well as your arms.
exercises.avoid: Pulling with a round back.

exercises.name: Tire lateral jump-overs
steps: Stand beside a tire lying flat.
Jump sideways over the whole tire, landing on the other side.
Jump straight back.
Keep going.
exercises.cue: Pull your knees up to clear the far wall.
exercises.avoid: Landing on the sidewall.

exercises.name: Burpee + tire jump-in
steps: Do a burpee beside the tire.
Jump into the middle of the tire.
Jump out the other side.
Burpee there and go back.
exercises.cue: Soft landings inside the tire.
exercises.avoid: Catching your foot on the sidewall.

exercises.name: Tire flip + sprint
steps: Flip the tire.
Sprint 15 m and back.
Flip it again.
Keep going for all rounds.
exercises.cue: Hinge for the flip; sprint for the run.
exercises.avoid: Pulling the flip with your back when tired.

exercises.name: Tire flip + push-ups
steps: Flip the tire.
Do 5 push-ups with your hands on the sidewall.
Flip it back.
Do 5 more push-ups. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Chest to the rim on every push-up.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the flip.

exercises.name: Landmine one-arm row
steps: Stand beside the end of the bar, hinge forward, one hand on your knee.
Grip the bar just below the end with your other hand.
Row it to your hip.
Lower slowly. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Elbow close to your ribs.
exercises.avoid: Twisting your torso to lift it.

exercises.name: Standing landmine chest press
steps: Face the bar end, holding it at your chest with both hands, in a staggered stance.
Press it up and away until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your chest.
Lean into it slightly.
exercises.cue: Push with your whole body, feet planted.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Landmine floor press
steps: Lie on your back beside the bar end, knees bent.
Hold the end above your chest with one hand.
Lower until your elbow touches the floor.
Press it back up. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Wrist straight over your elbow.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bar drift outward.

exercises.name: Landmine suitcase deadlift
steps: Stand beside the bar end, facing along the bar.
Squat down and grab the end with the hand nearest it.
Stand up without leaning toward it.
Lower. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Shoulders level: fight the lean.
exercises.avoid: Tilting toward the bar.

exercises.name: Landmine hack squat
steps: Face away from the anchor with the bar end resting on one shoulder, both hands holding it.
Walk your feet forward a little so you lean back into the bar.
Squat down, keeping your torso leaning back.
Drive back up.
exercises.cue: A towel on your shoulder makes it comfortable.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bar slide off your shoulder.

exercises.name: Landmine Cossack squat
steps: Hold the bar end at your chest, feet very wide.
Sit deep into one hip, the other leg straightening with toes up.
Push back through the middle to the other side.
Keep your chest up.
exercises.cue: The bar in front helps you balance deeper.
exercises.avoid: Heel lifting on the bent leg.

exercises.name: Landmine curtsy lunge
steps: Hold the bar end at your chest.
Step one foot back and across behind the other.
Lower until your back knee is close to the floor.
Return and switch sides.
exercises.cue: Hips stay square to the bar.
exercises.avoid: Front knee caving in.

exercises.name: Seated landmine twist
steps: Sit on the floor facing the bar end, knees bent, holding the end at your chest.
Lean back slightly.
Rotate the bar down toward one hip, then across to the other.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
exercises.cue: Turn your whole chest with the bar.
exercises.avoid: Letting the bar drop fast to one side.

exercises.name: Landmine rotational push press
steps: Stand side-on to the bar, holding the end at your back shoulder with the back hand.
Dip into your back hip, then pivot and drive up.
Press the bar up and across in one explosive move.
Lower back to your shoulder. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Hips turn first, arm fires last.
exercises.avoid: Pushing with only your arm.

exercises.name: Landmine high pull
steps: Straddle the bar facing the end, hands under the end.
Hinge and let the bar hang near your knees.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high.
Lower under control.
exercises.cue: Hips start it, arms finish it.
exercises.avoid: Pulling with a round back.

exercises.name: Landmine reverse lunge + press
steps: Hold the bar end at one shoulder.
Step back into a reverse lunge with the same-side leg.
At the bottom, press the bar up and forward.
Lower it, stand up. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Stay low and steady during the press.
exercises.avoid: Leaning over the front knee.

exercises.name: Landmine complex
steps: 5 landmine RDLs.
5 one-arm rows each side.
5 squat to presses.
5 split jerks each side. That's one round.
exercises.cue: Pick a load you can jerk when tired.
exercises.avoid: Letting the RDLs go round-backed.

exercises.name: Box drop and stick
steps: Stand on a low box.
Step off (don't jump) and land on both feet.
Absorb the landing into a half squat and freeze for two seconds.
Step back up and repeat.
exercises.cue: Land quiet: this is how you earn depth jumps.
exercises.avoid: Landing with straight legs or knees caving in.

exercises.name: Box toe taps
steps: Stand facing a low box.
Tap one foot on top of the box, then switch feet quickly, like running in place.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms.
exercises.cue: Quick, light touches.
exercises.avoid: Stomping on the box.

exercises.name: Lateral box step-overs
steps: Stand beside a low box.
Step up onto it with the near foot, bring the other foot up and over.
Step down the other side.
Keep going side to side, picking up the pace.
exercises.cue: Drive through the foot on the box.
exercises.avoid: Looking down at your feet the whole time.

exercises.name: Lateral box step-up
steps: Stand side-on to a box.
Put the near foot on the box and stand up on it, the other foot hovering.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: The top leg does all the work.
exercises.avoid: Pushing off the floor foot.

exercises.name: Crossover step-up
steps: Stand side-on to a box.
Cross your far foot over in front of you and plant it on the box.
Stand up on it.
Step down the way you came. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Hips stay square to the front.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving in as you drive up.

exercises.name: Low box rebound jumps
steps: Stand facing a low box.
Jump onto it and straight back down.
Bounce straight back up onto it.
Keep going with minimal ground contact.
exercises.cue: Springy and quick, like a pogo.
exercises.avoid: Using a box so high you have to pause.

exercises.name: 180° box jump
steps: Stand beside a box.
Jump and turn half a circle in the air, landing on the box.
Stand up tall, then step down.
Alternate turning directions.
exercises.cue: Turn early; land square on the box.
exercises.avoid: Clipping the edge; start with a low box.

exercises.name: Burpee box jump-over
steps: Do a burpee facing the box.
Jump onto the box or straight over it.
Land on the other side, turn around.
Burpee and go again.
exercises.cue: Soft landing on the far side.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the burpee to get to the jump.

exercises.name: Box jumps + sprint
steps: Do the box jumps, stepping down each time.
Sprint 15 m.
Walk back.
Repeat.
exercises.cue: Explosive jumps, then explosive running.
exercises.avoid: Jumping down from the box when tired.

exercises.name: Depth drop to sprint
steps: Stand on a low box at the start of your lane.
Step off, land and immediately sprint.
Sprint 10 to 15 m.
Walk back.
exercises.cue: The landing is the first step of the sprint.
exercises.avoid: Pausing after the landing.

exercises.name: Box step-up + reverse lunge
steps: Step up onto the box with one leg.
Step back down with the same leg.
Continue straight back into a reverse lunge with that leg.
Return to standing. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: One leg does both: up and back.
exercises.avoid: Rushing the transition.

exercises.name: Feet-on-box pike push-up
steps: Put your feet on a box and walk your hands back until your hips are high over your shoulders.
Lower your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up.
The higher the box, the harder.
exercises.cue: Elbows at 45 degrees, not flared.
exercises.avoid: Letting your hips drop.

exercises.name: Box plank up-downs
steps: Set up a forearm plank facing a box.
Place one hand on the box, then the other, into a high plank.
Come back down to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm.
exercises.cue: Hips still as you move.
exercises.avoid: Rocking side to side.

exercises.name: Incline mountain climbers
steps: Put your hands on the box or bench and set up a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch quickly.
Keep your hips low.
Count each knee.
exercises.cue: Hands on the box make it kinder to your wrists.
exercises.avoid: Hips bouncing.

exercises.name: Partner box jump + push-up relay
steps: One partner does 5 box jumps while the other holds the top of a push-up.
Swap.
Then swap again for push-ups: 5 push-ups while the other holds a squat.
That's one round.
exercises.cue: Hold positions strictly while you wait.
exercises.avoid: Resting in the hold.

exercises.name: Bench reverse hyper
steps: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the end and your legs hanging.
Hold the bench firmly.
Lift your straight legs until they're level with your body.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Squeeze your glutes to lift.
exercises.avoid: Swinging your legs up.

exercises.name: Bench lying leg raise
steps: Lie on a bench, holding its end behind your head.
Raise your straight legs until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly until just above bench height.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
exercises.cue: Bend your knees to make it easier.
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Decline bench sit-up
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline and hook your feet.
Lie back with your hands by your ears.
Sit up until your chest is upright.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Control the way down.
exercises.avoid: Yanking on your neck.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on a bench or box, knees bent.
Drive your heels down and lift your hips.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly. Lift one foot for a harder version.
exercises.cue: Push down through your heels.
exercises.avoid: Pushing up through your toes.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated plank
steps: Put your feet on a bench or box and your forearms on the floor.
Lift into a straight plank.
Squeeze your glutes and brace.
Hold.
exercises.cue: Straight line from head to heels.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging.

exercises.name: Incline burpee
steps: Stand facing a bench or box.
Put your hands on it and jump your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back in.
Stand and jump. The easier way into burpees.
exercises.cue: Keep your body straight in the plank.
exercises.avoid: Landing heavy on the jump.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated bench dips
steps: Put your hands on the edge of one bench and your heels on another bench or a box.
Lower until your elbows are at 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep your back close to the bench.
exercises.cue: Elbows point back.
exercises.avoid: Shoulders rolling forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell fly
steps: Lie on a bench with dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Open your arms wide with a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Squeeze them back together.
exercises.cue: Hug a big tree.
exercises.avoid: Going too deep; stop at the stretch.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press them overhead.
Lower to your shoulders.
Keep your back against the bench.
exercises.cue: Ribs down.
exercises.avoid: Arching away from the backrest.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
steps: Lie on the bench and grip the bar at shoulder-width.
Lower it to your lower chest, elbows close to your body.
Press it back up.
Use a spotter or safety arms.
exercises.cue: Elbows tucked; triceps do more work.
exercises.avoid: Grip so narrow your wrists bend.

exercises.name: Plate goblet squat
steps: Hold a plate against your chest, hands at 3 and 9 o'clock.
Squat down to at least parallel, chest up.
Drive up through your whole foot.
Keep the plate tight to your chest.
exercises.cue: Elbows inside your knees at the bottom.
exercises.avoid: Letting the plate pull your chest forward.

exercises.name: Plate overhead press
steps: Hold a plate by its rim at chest height.
Press it straight overhead until your arms lock.
Lower it back to your chest.
Squeeze your glutes throughout.
exercises.cue: Push your head through at the top.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back.

exercises.name: Plate steering wheel
steps: Hold a plate at 3 and 9 o'clock, arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
Turn it like a steering wheel as far as you can to one side.
Turn it back through the middle to the other side.
Keep your arms up the whole time.
exercises.cue: Shoulders burn, core stops the twist.
exercises.avoid: Letting the arms drop.

exercises.name: Plate front hold
steps: Hold a plate by its rim, arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
Stand tall, ribs down.
Hold without letting the plate drop.
Lower it slowly when the time's up.
exercises.cue: Pinch the rim hard; it helps your shoulders.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back to hold it up.

exercises.name: Plate front-hold walking lunge
steps: Hold a plate straight out in front at shoulder height.
Walk forward in lunges, keeping the plate up.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower the plate only at the end.
exercises.cue: Legs and shoulders on fire at the same time.
exercises.avoid: The plate sinking with every lunge.

exercises.name: Plate lateral lunge
steps: Hold a plate against your chest.
Step wide to one side and sit into that hip.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides.
exercises.cue: Heel down, hips back.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving in.

exercises.name: Plate good morning
steps: Hug a plate to your chest.
Soften your knees and push your hips back, lowering your chest.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.
exercises.cue: Flat back, hips back.
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back.

exercises.name: Plate glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, a plate resting on your hips.
Hold it in place with both hands.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Squeeze at the top for a second.
exercises.avoid: Pushing through your toes.

exercises.name: Plate V-up
steps: Lie on your back holding a light plate overhead.
Fold up, reaching the plate toward your feet as your legs lift.
Lower back down slowly.
Keep your legs straight if you can.
exercises.cue: Reach the plate past your toes.
exercises.avoid: Swinging the plate to get up.

exercises.name: Plate squat + press
steps: Hold a plate at your chest.
Squat down.
Stand up and press the plate overhead in one motion.
Lower it to your chest and go straight into the next squat.
exercises.cue: Use the legs to drive the press.
exercises.avoid: Pausing between the squat and the press.

exercises.name: Plate flip catch
steps: Pinch a light plate by its rim in one hand.
Let go and flip it over in the air.
Catch it by the rim again.
Stand on a mat in case you miss.
exercises.cue: Small flips first.
exercises.avoid: Doing this over your feet: step back.

exercises.name: Plate slider mountain climbers
steps: Put the plate face down on a towel on a smooth floor so it slides.
Put one foot on the towel-covered plate, or both feet on two, in a high plank.
Slide one knee toward your chest and back, then the other.
Keep your hips low.
exercises.cue: Smooth and fast.
exercises.avoid: Hips bouncing.

exercises.name: Plate slider reverse lunge
steps: Put the plate face down on a towel on a smooth floor so it slides.
Stand with one foot on the plate.
Slide that foot back into a reverse lunge.
Pull it back in to stand. Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: The front leg does the work.
exercises.avoid: Pushing through the sliding foot.

exercises.name: Plate slider pike
steps: Put the plate face down on a towel on a smooth floor so it slides.
Set up a high plank with both feet on the plate.
Pike your hips up high, sliding your feet toward your hands.
Slide back out to the plank.
exercises.cue: Shoulders stay over your hands.
exercises.avoid: Rounding into the pike too fast.

exercises.name: Plate slider body saw
steps: Put the plate face down on a towel on a smooth floor so it slides.
Set up a forearm plank with your feet on the plate.
Push your body back, sliding your feet, then pull forward.
Keep it short and controlled.
exercises.cue: The further back you go, the harder it gets.
exercises.avoid: Lower back sagging.

exercises.name: Plate slider bear crawl
steps: Put the plate face down on a towel on a smooth floor so it slides.
Put your feet on the plate in a high plank.
Walk forward on your hands, dragging your feet on the plate.
Keep going the whole length.
exercises.cue: Hips steady, core tight.
exercises.avoid: Hips swinging with each hand step.

exercises.name: Weighted vest Bulgarian split squat
steps: Put on the vest and rest your back foot on a bench.
Lower until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.cue: Front shin roughly vertical.
exercises.avoid: Bouncing off the back foot.

exercises.name: Weighted vest single-leg glute bridge
steps: Put on the vest and lie on your back, knees bent.
Lift one foot off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Finish all reps, then switch.
exercises.cue: Hips stay level.
exercises.avoid: The free side dropping.

exercises.name: Weighted vest Cossack squat
steps: Put on the vest and stand very wide.
Sit deep into one hip, the other leg straightening, toes up.
Shift through the middle to the other side.
Keep your chest up.
exercises.cue: Go as deep as you can with a flat heel.
exercises.avoid: Heel lifting.

exercises.name: Weighted vest chin-up
steps: Put on the vest and hang from the bar, palms facing you.
Pull your chin over the bar.
Lower all the way down.
Legs still.
exercises.cue: Pull your elbows to your ribs.
exercises.avoid: Kicking.

exercises.name: Weighted vest ring or TRX row
steps: Put on the vest and hold the handles, leaning back.
Pull your chest to your hands.
Lower slowly.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.
exercises.cue: Plank body throughout.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging under the vest.

exercises.name: Weighted vest bench dips
steps: Put on the vest and sit on the edge of a bench, hands beside your hips.
Slide off and lower until your elbows are at 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep your back close to the bench.
exercises.cue: Elbows point back.
exercises.avoid: Shoulders rolling forward.

exercises.name: Weighted vest pike push-up
steps: Put on the vest and set up a pike: hips high, hands and feet on the floor.
Lower your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up.
Keep your hips high.
exercises.cue: Elbows at 45 degrees.
exercises.avoid: The vest sliding toward your face: tighten it well.

exercises.name: Weighted vest wall walk
steps: Put on the vest and lie face down with your feet against a wall.
Push up and walk your feet up the wall while walking your hands in.
Get as close to the wall as you can.
Walk back down under control.
exercises.cue: Tight core so your back doesn't sag.
exercises.avoid: Rushing down; control every step.

exercises.name: Weighted vest sit-up
steps: Put on the vest and lie on your back, knees bent.
Sit all the way up.
Lower slowly.
Arms crossed over the vest.
exercises.cue: Control the lowering.
exercises.avoid: Yanking with your neck.

exercises.name: Weighted vest side plank
steps: Put on the vest and lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold.
Switch sides halfway through.
exercises.cue: Push the floor away with your forearm.
exercises.avoid: Hips sagging.

exercises.name: Weighted vest mountain climbers
steps: Put on the vest and set up a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch quickly.
Keep your hips low.
Count each knee.
exercises.cue: Shoulders over your hands.
exercises.avoid: Hips bouncing.

exercises.name: Weighted vest squat jumps
steps: Put on a light vest.
Sink into a half squat, arms back.
Jump as high as you can.
Land softly and reset.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: Stiff landings.

exercises.name: Weighted vest skater jumps
steps: Put on a light vest.
Leap sideways from one leg to the other.
Land softly and stick it for a moment.
Leap back.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: Knee caving in on the landing.

exercises.name: Weighted vest high knees
steps: Put on a light vest.
Run in place, driving your knees to hip height.
Pump your arms.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: Leaning back.

exercises.name: Weighted vest push-up + squat ladder
steps: Put on the vest.
Do 1 push-up and 1 squat, then 2 of each, then 3.
Keep climbing to the top number.
No rest between steps.
exercises.cue: Full range on every rep, even at the top.
exercises.avoid: Half reps as you tire.

exercises.name: Weighted vest burpee pull-up
steps: Put on a light vest and stand under the bar.
Do a burpee.
Jump up to the bar and do a pull-up.
Drop down softly and go again.
exercises.cue: Use a lighter vest for jumping than for strength work.
exercises.avoid: Dropping from the bar with straight legs.

exercises.name: Weighted vest shuttle walk
steps: Put on your heaviest vest.
Walk briskly up and down your 15 m lane.
Stand tall; don't lean forward.
Keep a steady pace for the time.
exercises.cue: Fast walking, not jogging.
exercises.avoid: Hunching under the weight.
